verses.1:1: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan, in the wilderness, toward the west, near the Red Sea, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Aulon, and Catachrysea.
verses.1:2: It is an eleven-day journey in Horeb to Mount
verses.1:3: Seir as far as Kadesh-barnea. And it happened in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke to all the sons of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded him for them, after striking down
verses.1:4: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
verses.1:5: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying:
verses.1:6: The Lord our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, "Let it be enough for you to live at this mountain.
verses.1:7: Turn and set out yourselves, and go into the hill country of the Amorites and to all the neighbors of Arabah, into hill country and plain, and toward the south, and the coastland, the land of the Canaanites, and Anti-Lebanon, as far as the great river Euphrates.
verses.1:8: See, He has delivered the land before you; go in and inherit the land that I swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them."
verses.1:9: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, "I will not be able to bear you alone.
verses.1:10: The Lord your God has multiplied you, and look, today you are like the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.1:11: May the Lord, the God of your fathers, add to you a thousand times as many as you are, and bless you just as He spoke to you.
verses.1:12: How will I alone be able to bear your trouble and your burden and your disputes?
verses.1:13: Provide for yourselves wise, knowledgeable, and discerning men for your tribes, and I will appoint them over you as your leaders."
verses.1:14: And you answered me and said, "The thing that you have spoken is good to do."
verses.1:15: And I took from among you wise, knowledgeable, and discerning men, and I appointed them to lead over you, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and commanders of tens, and recorders for your judges.
verses.1:16: And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, "Give a full hearing between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and a brother and his resident alien.
verses.1:17: You must not show partiality in judgment; you will judge the small and the great alike; you must never shrink back before the face of a man, for the judgment is God's. And whatever matter is too hard for you, you will bring it up to me, and I will hear you."
verses.1:18: And I commanded you at that time all the words that you were to do.
verses.1:19: And setting out from Horeb, we traveled through all that great and fearsome wilderness that you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorite, just as the Lord our God commanded us, and we came as far as Kadesh-barnea.
verses.1:20: And I said to you, "You have come as far as the hill country of the Amorite, which the Lord our God is giving to you.
verses.1:21: See, the Lord our God has delivered the land to you before your face; go up and inherit it, just as the Lord, the God of our fathers, said to you. Do not fear nor be dismayed."
verses.1:22: And all of you approached me and said, "Let us send men ahead of us, and let them scout out the land for us and bring back a report to us: the way by which we will go up and the cities into which we will enter."
verses.1:23: And the matter was pleasing before me, and I took from among you twelve men, one man for each tribe.
verses.1:24: And they turned and went up into the hill country, and came as far as the Valley of the Cluster, and spied it out.
verses.1:25: And they took in their hands some of the fruit of the land and brought it down to us, and they said, "The land that the Lord our God is giving to us is good."
verses.1:26: Yet you were not willing to go up, and you disobeyed the word of the Lord our God.
verses.1:27: And you grumbled in your tents and said, "Because the Lord hates us, He brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.1:28: Where are we going up?" Your brothers turned away your heart, saying, "A nation great and numerous and stronger than you, and cities great and walled up to heaven; moreover, we have even seen sons of giants there."
verses.1:29: And I said to you, "Do not be terrified nor be afraid of them.
verses.1:30: The Lord your God, who goes ahead before your face, He Himself will fight them with you according to all that He did for us in the land of Egypt, and in this wilderness that you saw by the way to the hill country of the Amorite, how He nurtured you, the Lord
verses.1:31: your God, as a man would nurture his son, along all the way on which you traveled until you came to this place."
verses.1:32: And in this matter you did not trust the Lord our God,
verses.1:33: who goes ahead of you on the way to choose a place for you, guiding you in fire by night, showing you the way along which you travel, and in a cloud by day.
verses.1:34: And the Lord heard the sound of your words, and being provoked, He swore, saying,
verses.1:35: "Surely not one of these men will see this good land that I swore to their fathers,
verses.1:36: except Caleb son of Jephunneh; he will see it, and to him I will give the land on which he set foot, and to his sons, because he was devoted to the things concerning the Lord."
verses.1:37: And the Lord was also angry with me because of you, saying, "You also will by no means enter there.
verses.1:38: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, he will enter there. Strengthen him, for he will cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.1:39: And every young child who today does not know good or evil, these will enter there, and to them I will give it, and they will inherit it."
verses.1:40: And you turned and encamped in the wilderness, by the way to the Red Sea.
verses.1:41: And you answered me and said, "We have sinned before the Lord our God; we will go up and fight according to all that the Lord our God commanded us." And each of you took up his weapons of war, and gathering together, you began going up into the hill country.
verses.1:42: And the Lord said to me, "Say to them, 'You must not go up, nor fight, for I am not with you, and you will not be crushed before your enemies.'"
verses.1:43: And I spoke to you, and you did not listen to me; and you transgressed the word of the Lord, and forcing your way, you went up into the hill country.
verses.1:44: And the Amorite who lived in that hill country came out to meet you, and they chased you as bees would do, and kept wounding you from Seir as far as Hormah.
verses.1:45: And sitting down, you wept before the Lord our God, and the Lord did not listen to your voice, nor did He pay attention to you.
verses.1:46: And you remained in Kadesh many days, as many days as you remained there.
verses.2:1: And we turned and set out into the wilderness, by the way of the Red Sea, just as the Lord spoke to me, and we went around Mount Seir for many days.
verses.2:2: And the Lord said to me,
verses.2:3: "Let it be enough for you to go around this mountain; turn, therefore, toward the north.
verses.2:4: And command the people, saying, 'You are passing through the territory of your brothers, the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, and they will fear you and be very wary of you.
verses.2:5: Do not engage in battle with them, for I will certainly not give you any of their land, not even a footstep, because I have given Mount Seir to the sons of Esau as an inheritance.
verses.2:6: Buy food from them for silver and you will eat, and you will obtain water from them by measure for silver and you will drink.'"
verses.2:7: For the Lord our God has blessed you in every work of your hands. Consider how you passed through that great and fearsome wilderness; look, for forty years the Lord your God has been with you; you have not lacked a thing.
verses.2:8: And we passed by your brothers, the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, along the way of the Arabah from Ailon and from Ezion-geber; and we turned and passed along the wilderness way of Moab.
verses.2:9: And the Lord said to me, "Do not be hostile to the Moabites, and do not engage in battle with them, for I will certainly not give you any of their land as an inheritance, for I have given Seir to the sons of Lot to inherit."
verses.2:10: The Emim formerly resided on it, a great and numerous nation, and strong like the Anakim.
verses.2:11: These also will be reckoned as Rephaim, like the Anakim; and the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.2:12: And in Seir the Horites resided previously, and the sons of Esau destroyed them and wiped them out from their presence, and settled in their place, just as Israel did to the land of his inheritance, which the Lord has given to them.
verses.2:13: "Now then, rise and set out yourselves, and cross over the valley of Zered." And we crossed over the valley of Zered.
verses.2:14: And the days during which we traveled from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the valley of Zered were thirty-eight years, until the entire generation of men of war perished, dying from the camp, just as God swore to them.
verses.2:15: And the hand of God was upon them to consume them from the midst of the camp, until they perished.
verses.2:16: And it came about, when all the men of war had perished, dying from the midst of the people,
verses.2:17: that the Lord spoke to me, saying,
verses.2:18: "You will pass by the borders of Moab, Seir, today,
verses.2:19: and you will draw near to the sons of Ammon. Do not be hostile to them and do not engage with them in battle, for I will certainly not give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon as an inheritance, because I have given it to the sons of Lot as an inheritance."
verses.2:20: It will be reckoned a land of Rephaim, for the Rephaim also lived on it previously, and the Ammonites call them Zochomein,
verses.2:21: a great and numerous nation, and mightier than you, like the Anakim. And the Lord destroyed them before their face, and they took possession and settled in their place until this day;
verses.2:22: just as they did for the sons of Esau who live in Seir, in the way they wiped out the Horites from their presence, and they took possession and settled in their place until this day.
verses.2:23: And as for the Hivites who lived in Hasedoth as far as Gaza, the Cappadocians who came out from Cappadocia wiped them out and settled in their place.
verses.2:24: "Now then, rise and set out, and cross over the valley of Arnon yourselves. See, I have handed over into your hands Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land. Begin to take possession; engage in battle with him. On this day
verses.2:25: begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the face of all the nations under heaven, who, upon hearing your name, will be thrown into turmoil, and pangs will seize them at your presence."
verses.2:26: And I sent envoys from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with peaceful words, saying,
verses.2:27: "I will pass through your land; I will pass along the road; I will not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.2:28: You will sell me food for silver and I will eat, and you will sell me water for silver and I will drink; only I will pass through on foot,
verses.2:29: just as the sons of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Aroer did for me, until I cross over the Jordan into the land which the Lord our God is giving to us."
verses.2:30: And Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing for us to pass by him, because the Lord our God hardened his spirit and strengthened his heart, so that he might be handed over into your hands, as on this day.
verses.2:31: And the Lord said to me, "See, I have begun to hand over before you Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land; begin to take possession of his land."
verses.2:32: And Sihon king of Heshbon came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle at Jahaz.
verses.2:33: And the Lord our God handed him over before us, and He struck him and his sons and all his people.
verses.2:34: And we captured all his cities at that time, and we utterly destroyed every city in succession, and their women and their children; we left no survivor.
verses.2:35: Only we plundered the livestock and took the spoil of the cities,
verses.2:36: from Aroer, which is beside the bank of the brook Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, and as far as Mount Gilead; there was not a city that escaped us; the Lord our God handed all of them over into our hands.
verses.2:37: Only we did not come near the sons of Ammon, all that borders the brook Jabbok and the cities in the hill country, just as the Lord our God commanded us.
verses.3:1: And we turned and went up by the way to Bashan; and Gog king of Bashan came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle at Edrei.
verses.3:2: And the Lord said to me, "Do not fear him, because I have handed him and all his people and all his land over into your hands; and you will do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon."
verses.3:3: And the Lord our God handed him over into our hands, even Og king of Bashan and all his people; and we struck him until we left no seed of his.
verses.3:4: And we captured all his cities at that time; there was not a city that we did not take from them: sixty cities, all the adjoining region of Argob of King Og in Bashan,
verses.3:5: all fortified cities, with high walls, gates, and bars, besides the cities of the Perizzites, which were very many.
verses.3:6: We utterly destroyed them, just as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, and we utterly destroyed every city in succession, and the women and the little children,
verses.3:7: and all the livestock; and we took the spoil of the cities as plunder for ourselves.
verses.3:8: And at that time we took the land from the hands of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the brook Arnon even as far as Hermon;
verses.3:9: the Phoenicians call Hermon Sanior, and the Amorites called it Senir;
verses.3:10: all the cities of Misor, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Elcha and Edrei, royal cities of Og in Bashan;
verses.3:11: for only Og king of Bashan was left of the Rephaim. Look, his bed is an iron bed; look, it is in the citadel of the sons of Ammon: nine cubits is its length and four cubits its width, by the cubit of a man.
verses.3:12: And we plundered that land at that time, from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook Arnon, and half of Mount Gilead; and its cities I gave to Reuben and to Gad.
verses.3:13: And the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Gog, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh, and all the region of Argob, all that land of Bashan; it will be reckoned a land of Rephaim.
verses.3:14: And Jair son of Manasseh took all the region of Arbok as far as the borders of Gartasei and Homachathei; he named them after his own name, Bassemath, Havvoth-jair, until this day.
verses.3:15: And to Machir I gave Gilead.
verses.3:16: And to Reuben and to Gad I have given from Gilead as far as the brook Arnon, and as far as the Jabbok; the brook is a border for the sons of Ammon;
verses.3:17: and the Arabah and the Jordan, the border of Machanareth and as far as the Sea of Arabah, the Salt Sea, below Ashdoth-pisgah to the east.
verses.3:18: And I commanded you at that time, saying, "The Lord our God has given you this land as an inheritance; armed, go ahead before your brothers, the sons of Israel, every mighty man.
verses.3:19: Only your wives and your children and your livestock (I know that you have much livestock), let them live in your cities which I gave you, until the Lord
verses.3:20: your God gives rest to your brothers just as He has to you, and they also take possession of the land which the Lord our God is giving to them beyond the Jordan; then you will return, each one to his inheritance which I gave you."
verses.3:21: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, "Your eyes have seen all that the Lord our God did to these two kings; so the Lord our God will do to all the kingdoms against which you are crossing over there.
verses.3:22: You shall not fear, because the Lord our God Himself fights for you."
verses.3:23: And I pleaded before the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.3:24: "Lord God, You have begun to show Your servant Your strength and Your power and the mighty hand and the uplifted arm; for what god is there in heaven or on earth who will do according to what You have done and according to Your strength?
verses.3:25: Having crossed over, then, I will see this good land that is beyond the Jordan, the good mountain and Anti-Lebanon."
verses.3:26: And the Lord overlooked me on account of you and did not listen to me; and the Lord said to me, "Let it be enough for you; do not continue to speak of this matter.
verses.3:27: Go up to the summit of the Hewn One, and looking up with your eyes toward the sea and north and south and east, see with your eyes, because you will not cross over this Jordan.
verses.3:28: And command Joshua, and strengthen him and encourage him, because he will cross over before this people, and he himself will cause them to inherit the land which you have seen."
verses.3:29: And we stayed in a valley near the house of Peor.
verses.4:1: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and the judgments, all that I am teaching you today to do, so that you may live and be multiplied, and enter and inherit the land that the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving to you.
verses.4:2: You shall not add to the word that I command you, and you shall not take away from it; keep the commandments of the Lord your God, all that I command you today.
verses.4:3: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord our God did to Baal-peor, for every man who walked after Baal-peor, the Lord your God wiped him out from among us;
verses.4:4: but you who hold fast to the Lord your God are all alive on this day.
verses.4:5: Look, I have shown you statutes and judgments, just as the Lord commanded me, to do so in the land into which you are entering to inherit it;
verses.4:6: and you shall keep and do them, for this is your wisdom and understanding before all nations, as many as hear all these statutes, and they will say, "Look, this great nation is a wise and knowledgeable people."
verses.4:7: For what great nation is there that has a god drawing near to them like the Lord our God in all things in which we call upon Him?
verses.4:8: And what great nation is there that has righteous statutes and judgments like all this law that I am giving to you today?
verses.4:9: Watch yourself and guard your soul diligently, so that you do not forget all the words that your eyes have seen, and let them not depart from your heart all the days of your life; and you shall instruct your sons and the sons of your sons: the day you stood before the Lord our God at Horeb on the day of the assembly,
verses.4:10: when the Lord said to me, "Assemble the people to Me, and let them hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live on the earth, and they shall teach their sons."
verses.4:11: And you came near and stood beneath the mountain; and the mountain was burning with fire up to heaven, darkness, gloom, storm, a loud voice.
verses.4:12: And the Lord spoke to you from the midst of the fire a voice of words that you heard, and you saw no likeness, only a voice;
verses.4:13: and He declared to you His covenant that He commanded you to do, the ten words, and He wrote them on two stone tablets.
verses.4:14: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, for you to do them in the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.4:15: And you shall guard your souls diligently, because you saw no likeness on the day when the Lord spoke to you at Horeb on the mountain from the midst of the fire;
verses.4:16: so that you do not act lawlessly and make for yourselves a carved likeness, any image, the likeness of male or female,
verses.4:17: the likeness of any beast among those on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies under heaven,
verses.4:18: the likeness of any creeping thing that creeps on the earth, the likeness of any fish among those in the waters beneath the earth;
verses.4:19: and so that, looking up to heaven and seeing the sun and the moon and the stars and all the array of heaven, being led astray, you do not bow down to them and serve them, which the Lord your God apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
verses.4:20: But God took you and brought us out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be for Him a heritage people, as on this day.
verses.4:21: And the Lord was angry with me concerning the things spoken by you, and He swore that I should not cross this Jordan, and that I should not enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you as an inheritance.
verses.4:22: For I am dying in this land, and I am not crossing the Jordan; but you are crossing over and will inherit this good land.
verses.4:23: Watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the covenant of the Lord your God that He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved likeness of anything that the Lord your God commanded;
verses.4:24: because the Lord your God is a fire that consumes, a jealous God.
verses.4:25: Now if you father sons and sons of your sons, and you remain a long time in the land, and act lawlessly and make a carved likeness of anything, and do what is evil before the Lord
verses.4:26: your God to provoke Him to anger, I call both heaven and earth to witness against you today that you will utterly perish from the land you are crossing the Jordan to inherit; you will not prolong days on it, but instead you will be utterly wiped out.
verses.4:27: And the Lord will scatter you among all the nations, and you will be left few in number among the nations into which the Lord will bring you.
verses.4:28: And there you will serve other gods, works of human hands, wood and stone, which will not see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.4:29: And there you will seek the Lord our God, and you will find Him, whenever you search for Him with all your heart and with all your soul in your affliction;
verses.4:30: and all these words will find you at the end of the days, and you will turn back to the Lord your God and heed His voice;
verses.4:31: for the Lord your God is a compassionate God; He will not abandon you nor will He wipe you out; He will not forget the covenant of your fathers that He swore to them.
verses.4:32: Inquire about former days that were before you, from the day when God created man on the earth, and toward one end of heaven as far as the other end of heaven, whether anything like this great matter has happened, whether such a thing has been heard; whether a nation has heard the voice
verses.4:33: of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, in the way that you yourself have heard and lived;
verses.4:34: whether God has tried to go in and take for Himself a nation from the midst of a nation, with testing and with signs and with wonders and with war and with a mighty hand and with an uplifted arm and with great visions, according to all that our God did in Egypt before you as you watched;
verses.4:35: so that you might know that the Lord your God, He is God, and there is no other besides Him.
verses.4:36: Out of heaven His voice was made audible to discipline you, and on the earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words from the midst of the fire.
verses.4:37: Because He loved your fathers, He also chose their seed after them—you—and He Himself brought you out of Egypt by His great strength,
verses.4:38: and to utterly destroy nations great and stronger than you before your face, to bring you in, to give you their land to inherit, just as you have today.
verses.4:39: And you shall know today and turn back in your mind that the Lord your God, He is God in heaven above and on the earth below, and there is no other besides Him;
verses.4:40: and keep His statutes and His commandments, all that I command you today, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you, so that you may be long-lived in the land that the Lord your God is giving to you for all the days.
verses.4:41: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
verses.4:42: for the killer to flee there who kills his neighbor unknowingly, and who did not hate him before yesterday or before the third day; and he will flee for refuge into one of these cities and live:
verses.4:43: Bezer in the wilderness, in the level land, for Reuben; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadite; and Golan in Bashan for Manasseh.
verses.4:44: This is the law that Moses placed before the sons of Israel;
verses.4:45: these are the testimonies and the statutes and the judgments, all that Moses spoke to the sons of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt,
verses.4:46: in the region beyond the Jordan, in a valley near the house of Peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel struck down when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.4:47: And they inherited his land and the land of Gog, king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun;
verses.4:48: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook Arnon, and up to Mount Seon, which is Hermon,
verses.4:49: all the Arabah beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from Ashdoth the hewn.
verses.5:1: And Moses called all Israel and said to them, "Hear, Israel, the statutes and the judgments that I am speaking in your ears on this day, and you shall learn them and be careful to do them.
verses.5:2: The Lord your God made a covenant with you at Horeb.
verses.5:3: The Lord did not make this covenant with your fathers, but with you—you who are all alive here today.
verses.5:4: Face to face the Lord spoke to you on the mountain out of the midst of the fire,
verses.5:5: and I was standing between the Lord and you at that time to declare to you the words of the Lord, because you were afraid before the fire and did not go up onto the mountain, saying:
verses.5:6: 'I am the Lord your God, who led you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.5:7: You shall not have other gods before My face.
verses.5:8: You shall not make for yourself an idol, nor a likeness of anything—of all that is in heaven above, and all that is on the earth below, and all that is in the waters beneath the earth.
verses.5:9: You shall not bow down to them, nor serve them at all; for I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation for those who hate Me,
verses.5:10: and showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and to those who keep My decrees.
verses.5:11: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain; for the Lord will by no means clear the one who takes His name in vain.
verses.5:12: Keep the Sabbath day to sanctify it, just as the Lord your God commanded you.
verses.5:13: Six days you shall labor and do all your works,
verses.5:14: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; you shall not do any work on it—you and your sons and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, your ox and your draft animal and all your livestock, the resident alien who lives among you; for in six days the Lord made both heaven and earth, and the sea, and all that is in them; so that your male servant and your female servant may rest just as you do.
verses.5:15: And you shall remember that you were a household servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God led you out from there with a mighty hand and with an uplifted arm; for this reason the Lord your God ordered you to keep the Sabbath day and to sanctify it.
verses.5:16: Honor your father and your mother, just as the Lord your God commanded, so that it may go well with you, and so that you may live long upon the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.5:20: You shall not testify falsely against your neighbor with false testimony.
verses.5:21: You shall not covet the wife of your neighbor; you shall not covet the house of your neighbor, nor his field, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his draft animal, nor any of his livestock, nor anything that belongs to your neighbor.'
verses.5:22: These words the Lord spoke to all your assembly on the mountain out of the midst of the fire—darkness, gloom, storm, a loud voice—and He added no more; and He wrote them on two tablets and gave them to me.
verses.5:23: And it happened, when you heard the voice out of the midst of the fire, and the mountain was burning with fire, that you approached me, all the leaders of your tribes and your council of elders;
verses.5:24: and you were saying, 'Look, the Lord our God has shown His glory, and we have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire; on this day we have seen that God will speak to a man, and he will live.
verses.5:25: And now let us not die, for this great fire will consume us; if we ourselves continue to hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer, then we will die.
verses.5:26: For what flesh is there that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and will live?
verses.5:27: You approach and hear all that the Lord our God may say, and you shall speak to us everything that the Lord our God may speak to you, and we will hear and we will do.'
verses.5:28: And the Lord heard the voice of your words as you were speaking to me, and the Lord said to me, 'I have heard the voice of the words of this people, all that they have spoken to you; everything that they have spoken is right.
verses.5:29: Who will grant that their heart be like this within them, so as to fear Me and to keep My commandments all the days, so that it may go well with them and with their sons forever?
verses.5:30: Go, say to them, "Return to your houses."
verses.5:31: But you, stand here with Me, and I will speak to you the commandments and the statutes and the judgments that you shall teach them; and let them do them in the land that I am giving them as an inheritance.'
verses.5:32: And you shall be careful to do just as the Lord your God commanded you; you shall not turn aside to the right nor to the left,
verses.5:33: in all the way that the Lord your God commanded you, to walk in it, so that He may give you rest, and it may go well with you, and you may prolong your days upon the land that you will inherit."
verses.6:1: And these are the commandments and the statutes and the judgments that our God commanded to teach you to do so in the land into which you are entering to inherit it,
verses.6:2: so that you may fear the Lord your God; keep all His statutes and His commandments that I am commanding you today—you and your sons and the sons of your sons—all the days of your life, so that you may prolong your days.
verses.6:3: And hear, Israel, and be careful to do so, so that it may go well with you, and so that you may be greatly multiplied, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, spoke to give you a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.6:4: And these are the statutes and the judgments that the Lord commanded the sons of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt. Hear, Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord;
verses.6:5: and you shall love the Lord your God with all your mind and with all your soul and with all your strength.
verses.6:6: And these words that I am commanding you today shall be in your heart and in your soul;
verses.6:7: and you shall instruct your sons, and you shall speak of them when sitting in the house and when walking on the road, and when lying down and when rising up;
verses.6:8: and you shall fasten them as a sign upon your hand, and it shall be immovable before your eyes;
verses.6:9: and you shall write them upon the doorposts of your houses and of your gates.
verses.6:10: And it shall be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land that the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give you great and fine cities that you did not build,
verses.6:11: houses full of all good things that you did not fill, hewn cisterns that you did not hew, vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant, and when you have eaten and been filled, watch yourself that you do not forget
verses.6:12: the Lord your God, who led you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.6:13: The Lord your God you shall fear, and Him you shall serve, and to Him you shall cling, and by His name you shall swear.
verses.6:14: You shall not go after other gods from the nations that are all around you,
verses.6:15: for the Lord your God among you is a jealous God; otherwise the Lord your God, becoming angry, may be enraged against you; He will utterly destroy you from the face of the earth.
verses.6:16: You shall not test the Lord your God, just as you tested Him at the Testing.
verses.6:17: You shall carefully keep the commandments of the Lord your God, the testimonies and the statutes that He commanded you;
verses.6:18: and you shall do what is pleasing and what is fine before the Lord your God, so that it may go well with you, and you may enter and inherit the good land that the Lord swore to your fathers,
verses.6:19: to drive out all your enemies from before your face, just as the Lord spoke.
verses.6:20: And it shall be, when your son asks you tomorrow, saying, "What are the testimonies and the statutes and the judgments that the Lord our God commanded us?"
verses.6:21: then you shall say to your son, "We were household servants to Pharaoh in the land of Egypt, and the Lord led us out from there with a mighty hand and with an uplifted arm;
verses.6:22: and the Lord gave signs and wonders, great and grievous, in Egypt, against Pharaoh and against his house, before us,
verses.6:23: and He led us out from there to give us this land that He swore to give to our fathers;
verses.6:24: and the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, so that it may go well with us all the days, so that we may live, just as today;
verses.6:25: and there will be mercy for us if we are careful to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, just as the Lord commanded us."
verses.7:1: Now when the Lord your God brings you into the land into which you are entering there to inherit it, He will remove great nations from before you—the Hittite, the Amorite, the Girgashite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations, numerous and stronger than you—
verses.7:2: and the Lord your God will deliver them into your hands, and you will strike them; with obliteration you shall obliterate them. You shall not make a covenant with them, nor shall you show mercy to them,
verses.7:3: nor shall you intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter to his son, and you shall not take his daughter for your son.
verses.7:4: For he will turn your son away from Me, and he will serve other gods; and the Lord will be angered with wrath against you, and He will utterly destroy you quickly.
verses.7:5: Instead, you shall do this to them: you shall tear down their altars, and you shall shatter their pillars, and you shall cut down their sacred groves, and you shall burn up the carved images of their gods with fire.
verses.7:6: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord your God selected you to be a special people for Him above all the nations that are on the face of the earth.
verses.7:7: It is not because you are more numerous than all the nations that the Lord selected you and chose you, for you are the fewest of all the nations;
verses.7:8: rather, because the Lord loves you, and keeping the oath that He swore to your fathers, the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
verses.7:9: And you will know today that the Lord your God, He is God, a faithful God, who keeps covenant and mercy for those who love Him and for those who keep His commandments, to a thousand generations,
verses.7:10: and who repays those who hate to their face, to utterly destroy them; and He will not delay toward those who hate; to their face He will repay them.
verses.7:11: And you shall keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments, all that I command you today to do.
verses.7:12: And it will be, if you listen to these statutes and keep and do them, that the Lord your God will faithfully keep for you the covenant and the mercy that He swore to your fathers;
verses.7:13: and the Lord will love you and bless you and multiply you, and He will bless the offspring of your womb and the fruit of your land, your grain and your wine and your oil, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep, on the land, as the Lord swore to your fathers to give to you.
verses.7:14: You will be blessed above all the nations; there will not be among you a sterile male or a barren female, nor among your livestock.
verses.7:15: And the Lord will take away from you every sickness; and all the evil diseases of Egypt that you have seen and all that you knew, He will not lay upon you, but He will lay them upon all those who hate you.
verses.7:16: And you will eat all the spoils of the nations that the Lord your God is giving to you; your eye shall not spare them, and you shall not serve their gods, for this is a stumbling block to you.
verses.7:17: Now if you say in your mind, "This nation is more numerous than I; how will I be able to utterly destroy them?"
verses.7:18: you shall not fear them; with remembrance you shall remember all that the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all the Egyptians,
verses.7:19: the great trials that your eyes saw, the signs and the wonders, the mighty hand and the uplifted arm, how the Lord your God brought you out. So the Lord our God will do to all the nations whom you fear before their face.
verses.7:20: And the Lord your God will send the hornets among them, until those who are left behind and those who are hidden from you are wiped out.
verses.7:21: You will not be wounded before them, for the Lord your God is among you, a great and mighty God.
verses.7:22: And the Lord your God will consume these nations from before you little by little; you will not be able to completely consume them quickly, so that the land may not become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against you.
verses.7:23: And the Lord your God will deliver them into your hands, and you will destroy them with a great destruction until He utterly destroys them.
verses.7:24: And He will deliver their kings into your hands, and their name will perish from the place of those people; no one will resist before your face until He utterly destroys them.
verses.7:25: You shall burn the carved images of their gods in fire; you shall not covet silver and gold from them; you shall not take it for yourself, so that you do not stumble because of it, for it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.7:26: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, and become an accursed thing just like it; with loathing you shall loathe it and with detestation you shall detest it, for it is an accursed thing.
verses.8:1: All the commandments that I command you today you shall be careful to do, so that you may live and be multiplied, and enter and inherit the land that the Lord your God swore to your fathers.
verses.8:2: And you shall remember all the way along which the Lord your God led you in the wilderness, so that He might afflict you and thoroughly test you, and the things in your heart might be discerned, whether you would keep His commandments or not.
verses.8:3: And He afflicted you and made you suffer hunger, and fed you the manna that your fathers did not know, so that He might declare to you that man will not live on bread alone, but on every word that goes out through the mouth of God man will live.
verses.8:4: Your garments did not wear out off you, your sandals did not wear away off you, your feet did not become calloused—look, forty years.
verses.8:5: And you will know in your heart that as if a man were to discipline his son, so the Lord your God will discipline you.
verses.8:6: And you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
verses.8:7: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good and large land, where there are streams of water, springs of the deep going out through the plains and through the mountains;
verses.8:8: a land of wheat and barley, vines, fig trees, pomegranates, a land of olive trees of oil and honey;
verses.8:9: a land on which you will eat your bread without poverty, and you will not lack anything on it; a land whose stones are iron, and from its mountains you will mine copper.
verses.8:10: And you will eat and be filled, and you will bless the Lord your God on the good land that He gave you.
verses.8:11: Watch yourself so that you do not forget the Lord your God by not keeping His commandments and the judgments and His statutes, all that I command you today;
verses.8:12: so that, when you have eaten and been filled, and have built fine houses and lived in them,
verses.8:13: and when your cattle have multiplied and your sheep have multiplied, when silver and gold have multiplied for you, and all that you will have has multiplied for you,
verses.8:14: you do not become lifted up in heart and forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery;
verses.8:15: who led you through that great and fearsome wilderness, where there was biting serpent and scorpion and thirst, where there was no water; who brought out for you from sheer rock a spring of water;
verses.8:16: who fed you the manna in the wilderness, which your fathers did not know, so that He might afflict you and thoroughly test you, and do good to you at the end of your days.
verses.8:17: Do not say in your heart, "My strength and the might of my hand produced for me this great power."
verses.8:18: And you shall remember the Lord your God, for He Himself gives you the strength to produce power, and so that He may establish the covenant that the Lord swore to your fathers, as it is today.
verses.8:19: And it will be, if with forgetfulness you forget the Lord your God, and walk after other gods and serve them, I solemnly testify to you today that by destruction you will perish;
verses.8:20: just as also the remaining nations that the Lord is destroying before your face, so you will perish, because you did not listen to the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.9:1: Hear, Israel: you are crossing this Jordan today to go in to inherit nations great and far stronger than you, cities great and walled up to heaven,
verses.9:2: a people great and numerous and tall, sons of Anak, whom you know, and you yourself have heard, "Who will stand in the face of the sons of Anak?"
verses.9:3: And you shall know today that the Lord your God, He goes ahead before you; He is a consuming fire. He will utterly destroy them, and He will turn them back from before you, and you will destroy them just as the Lord told you.
verses.9:4: Do not say in your heart, when the Lord your God utterly consumes these nations from sight, saying, "Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to inherit this good land."
verses.9:5: It is not because of your righteousness nor because of the holiness of your heart that you are going in to inherit their land, but because of the ungodliness of these nations the Lord will utterly destroy them from before you, and so that He may establish His covenant which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.9:6: And you shall know today that it is not because of your righteous deeds that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to inherit, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.9:7: Remember, do not forget how much you provoked the Lord your God in the wilderness. From the day you came out of Egypt and came to this place, you have continued being disobedient toward the Lord.
verses.9:8: Even at Horeb you provoked the Lord, and He was furious with you, so as to utterly destroy you,
verses.9:9: when I was going up the mountain to receive the stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant which the Lord made with you. And I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.
verses.9:10: And the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, written with the finger of God, and on them were written all the words which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
verses.9:11: And it came about after forty days and forty nights that the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.9:12: And the Lord said to me, "Rise, go down quickly from here, because your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt have acted lawlessly. They have quickly turned aside from the way that you commanded them, and they have made for themselves a cast image."
verses.9:13: And the Lord said to me, "I have spoken to you once and twice, saying, 'I have seen this people, and look, it is a stiff-necked people.'
verses.9:14: And now let Me utterly destroy them, and I will blot out their name from under heaven, and I will make you into a nation great and strong and far more numerous than this one."
verses.9:15: And I turned and went down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire up to heaven, and the two tablets were in my two hands.
verses.9:16: And when I saw that you had sinned before the Lord your God, and had made for yourselves a cast image, and had turned aside from the way that the Lord had commanded you,
verses.9:17: I took hold of the two tablets and threw them from my two hands, and I shattered them before you.
verses.9:18: And I pleaded before the Lord a second time, just as the first time, forty days and forty nights—I ate no bread and drank no water—because of all your sins that you had sinned, in doing what was evil before the Lord God to provoke Him.
verses.9:19: And I am terrified because of the wrath and the fury, because the Lord was provoked against you, so as to utterly destroy you. And the Lord listened to me at this time also.
verses.9:20: And He was furious with Aaron, so as to utterly destroy him, and I prayed for Aaron also at that time.
verses.9:21: And your sin which you had made, the calf—I took it and burned it up in fire, and crushed it, grinding it thoroughly until it became fine; and it became like dust, and I threw the dust into the stream coming down from the mountain.
verses.9:22: And at the Burning, and at the Testing, and at the Graves of Craving, you were provoking the Lord.
verses.9:23: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, saying, "Go up and inherit the land which I am giving you," you disobeyed the word of the Lord your God, and you did not believe Him, and you did not listen to His voice.
verses.9:24: You have been disobedient toward the Lord from the day He became known to you.
verses.9:25: And I pleaded before the Lord for the forty days and forty nights that I pleaded, for the Lord had said He would utterly destroy you.
verses.9:26: And I prayed to God and said, "Lord, King of the gods, do not utterly destroy Your people and Your portion which You redeemed, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with Your great strength and with Your mighty hand and with Your uplifted arm.
verses.9:27: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Your servants, to whom You swore by Yourself; do not look upon the stubbornness of this people and their ungodly deeds and their sins,
verses.9:28: so that those who inhabit the land from which You brought us out may not say, 'Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land of which He spoke to them, and because He hated them, He brought them out into the wilderness to kill them.'
verses.9:29: And these are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with Your great strength and with Your mighty hand and with Your uplifted arm."
verses.10:1: At that time the Lord said to me, "Chisel for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and come up to Me on the mountain, and you shall make for yourself a wooden ark,
verses.10:2: and you shall write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you shattered, and you shall put them into the ark."
verses.10:3: And I made an ark of imperishable wood, and I chiseled the stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up the mountain, and the two tablets were in my hands.
verses.10:4: And He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten words which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire, and the Lord gave them to me.
verses.10:5: And I turned and went down from the mountain, and I put the tablets into the ark which I had made, and they were there, just as the Lord had commanded me.
verses.10:6: And the sons of Israel set out from Beeroth of the sons of Jakim Misadai; there Aaron died and was buried there, and Eleazar his son served as priest in his place.
verses.10:7: From there they set out to Gadgad, and from Gadgad to Taibatha, a land of streams of water.
verses.10:8: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord, to minister and to invoke blessings in His name to this day.
verses.10:9: Therefore the Levites have no portion or inheritance among their brothers; the Lord Himself is his inheritance, just as He told him.
verses.10:10: And I stood on the mountain forty days and forty nights, and the Lord heard me at this time also, and the Lord was not willing to utterly destroy you.
verses.10:11: And the Lord said to me, "Go, set out before this people, and let them go in and inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them."
verses.10:12: And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you except to fear the Lord your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the Lord your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul,
verses.10:13: to keep the commandments of the Lord your God and His statutes, all that I am commanding you today, so that it may go well with you?
verses.10:14: Look, to the Lord your God belong heaven and the heaven of heaven, the earth and all things that are in it.
verses.10:15: Yet the Lord selected your fathers, to love them, and He chose their seed after them—you—above all the nations, as on this day.
verses.10:16: And you shall circumcise the hardness of your heart, and you shall not stiffen your neck.
verses.10:17: For the Lord your God, He is God of gods and Lord of lords, the God who is great, strong, and awesome, who shows no partiality and will by no means take a bribe,
verses.10:18: executing justice for the resident alien and the orphan and the widow, and He loves the resident alien, giving him bread and clothing.
verses.10:19: And you shall love the resident alien, for you were resident aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.10:20: The Lord your God you shall fear, and you shall serve Him, and cling to Him, and swear by His name.
verses.10:21: He is your boast and He is your God, who did among you these great and glorious things which your eyes saw.
verses.10:22: With seventy souls your fathers went down to Egypt, but now the Lord your God has made you like the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.11:1: And you shall love the Lord your God, and you shall keep His requirements and His statutes and His judgments all the days.
verses.11:2: And you shall know today that it is not your children, who do not know and have not seen the discipline of the Lord your God, and His great deeds, and the mighty hand and the uplifted arm,
verses.11:3: and His signs and His wonders, all that He did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to all his land,
verses.11:4: and all that He did to the army of the Egyptians, their chariots and their cavalry and their army, how He flooded the water of the Red Sea over their faces while they were pursuing behind you, and the Lord destroyed them until this day,
verses.11:5: and all that He did for us in the wilderness until you came to this place,
verses.11:6: and all that He did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, son of Reuben, whom the earth, opening its mouth, swallowed—them and their households and their tents and all their possessions that were with them in the midst of all Israel;
verses.11:7: for your eyes have seen all the works of the Lord that He has done for you today.
verses.11:8: And you shall keep all His commandments that I am commanding you today, so that you may live and be multiplied, and you will go in and inherit the land into which you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it,
verses.11:9: so that you may live long on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed after them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.11:10: For the land into which you are entering to inherit it is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come out, when they sow the seed and water it with their feet like a vegetable garden;
verses.11:11: but the land into which you are entering to inherit it is a land of mountains and plains; from the rain of heaven it will drink water;
verses.11:12: a land that the Lord your God watches over continually; the eyes of the Lord your God are upon it from the beginning of the year even until the end of the year.
verses.11:13: Now if you diligently listen to all the commandments that I am commanding you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.11:14: then He will give the rain for your land in its season, early and late, and you will bring in your grain and your wine and your oil;
verses.11:15: and He will give fodder in your fields for your livestock. And when you have eaten and been filled,
verses.11:16: watch yourself that your heart is not widened, and that you do not transgress and serve other gods and bow down to them;
verses.11:17: and the Lord will become enraged with anger against you and shut up heaven, and there will be no rain, and the land will not give its fruit, and you will perish quickly from the good land that the Lord has given you.
verses.11:18: And you shall place these words in your heart and in your soul, and you shall fasten them as a sign upon your hand, and it shall be immovable before your eyes;
verses.11:19: and you shall teach them to your children, to speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk on the way, and when you sleep and when you rise up;
verses.11:20: and you shall write them on the doorposts of your houses and of your gates,
verses.11:21: so that you may live long, and the days of your sons on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them may be like the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.11:22: And it will be that if you diligently listen to all these commandments that I am commanding you today to do, to love the Lord our God and to walk in all His ways, to cling to Him,
verses.11:23: then the Lord will drive out all these nations from before you, and you will inherit nations greater and stronger than you.
verses.11:24: Every place where the sole of your foot treads will be yours; from the wilderness and Anti-Lebanon, and from the great river, the river Euphrates, even to the sea on the west will be your borders.
verses.11:25: No one will take a stand before you; the Lord your God will put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the face of all the land on which you set foot, just as He spoke to you.
verses.11:26: See, I am setting before you today the blessing and the curse:
verses.11:27: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the Lord your God that I am commanding you today;
verses.11:28: and the curses, if you do not listen to the commandments of the Lord your God, all that I am commanding you today, and stray from the way that I commanded you, going to serve other gods whom you do not know.
verses.11:29: And it will be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land into which you are crossing to inherit it, that you shall give a blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
verses.11:30: Look, are these not beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the setting sun, in the land of Canaan, which dwells toward the west, adjoining Gilgal, near the high oak?
verses.11:31: For you are crossing the Jordan, going in to inherit the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance all the days, and you will dwell in it.
verses.11:32: And you shall be careful to do all His ordinances and these judgments, all that I am setting before you today.
verses.12:1: And these are the ordinances and the judgments that you shall be careful to do in the land that the Lord, the God of our fathers, is giving you as an inheritance all the days that you live upon the earth.
verses.12:2: You shall utterly destroy all the places where those whom you are inheriting served their gods, upon the high mountains and upon the hills and under a leafy tree;
verses.12:3: and tear down their altars, and you shall shatter their pillars, and their sacred groves you shall cut down, and burn the carved images of their gods with fire; and their name will perish from that place.
verses.12:4: You shall not do so to the Lord your God;
verses.12:5: rather, to the place that the Lord your God chooses in one of your cities, to name His name there to be called upon—seek there,
verses.12:6: and you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your pledged offerings, the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep;
verses.12:7: and you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice in everything to which you put your hand, you and your households, as the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.12:8: You shall not do all the things that we are doing here today, each one what is pleasing in his own sight;
verses.12:9: for until now you have not come into the rest and into the inheritance that the Lord our God is giving you.
verses.12:10: And you will cross the Jordan and dwell in the land that the Lord our God is giving you as an inheritance, and He will give you rest from all your enemies all around, and you will dwell in security.
verses.12:11: And it will be, to the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there, you shall bring all that I am commanding you today: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, and your tithes and the firstfruits of your hands, and every choice one of your gifts, all that you vow to God;
verses.12:12: and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, your male servants and your female servants, and the Levite who is at your gates, because he has no portion or inheritance with you.
verses.12:13: Watch yourself that you do not offer up your burnt offerings in every place that you see,
verses.12:14: but rather in the place that the Lord your God chooses in one of your tribes; there you shall offer up your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I am commanding you today.
verses.12:15: However, with all your desire you may slaughter and eat meat, according to the blessing of the Lord your God that He has given you in every city; the unclean among you and the clean alike may eat it, like a gazelle or a deer;
verses.12:16: only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.12:17: You may not eat in your cities the tithe of your grain and of your wine and of your oil, the firstborn of your cattle, and all vows that you vow, and your pledged offerings, and the firstfruits of your hands;
verses.12:18: rather, before the Lord your God you shall eat it in the place that the Lord your God chooses for Himself, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the resident alien who is in your cities; and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in everything to which you put your hand.
verses.12:19: Watch yourself that you do not forsake the Levite all the time that you live on the land.
verses.12:20: Now if the Lord your God enlarges your borders, just as He spoke to you, and you say, "I will eat meat," if your soul desires to eat meat, with all the desire of your soul you may eat meat.
verses.12:21: And if the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there is far away from you, then you may slaughter from your cattle and from your sheep that God gives you, just as I commanded you, and you may eat in your cities according to the desire of your soul;
verses.12:22: just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you may eat it; the unclean among you and the clean may likewise eat.
verses.12:23: Be very careful not to eat blood, because its blood is life; the life shall not be eaten with the meat.
verses.12:24: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.12:25: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
verses.12:26: Only you shall take your holy things, if you have any, and your vows, and come to the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there;
verses.12:27: and you shall offer your burnt offerings; but the meat you shall eat.
verses.12:28: Be careful and listen, and you shall do all the words that I am commanding you, so that it may go well with you and with your sons forever, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
verses.12:29: Now if the Lord your God utterly destroys from before you the nations among whom you are entering to inherit their land, and you inherit it and dwell in their land,
verses.12:30: watch yourself that you do not seek to follow after them after they have been utterly destroyed from before you, saying, "How do these nations act toward their gods? I also will do so."
verses.12:31: You shall not do so to your God; for the abominations of the Lord, which He hated, they have done with their gods, because they burn their sons and their daughters in fire to their gods.
verses.13:1: Every word that I command you today, this you shall take care to do; you shall not add to it, nor shall you take away from it.
verses.13:2: Now if a prophet or one who dreams a dream arises among you and gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.13:3: and the sign or the wonder comes about of which he spoke to you, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods," whom you do not know,
verses.13:4: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or of the one who dreams that dream; for the Lord your God is testing you, to know whether you love your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.13:5: Walk after the Lord your God, and you shall fear Him, and you shall listen to His voice, and to Him you shall be joined.
verses.13:6: And that prophet or that one who dreams the dream shall die; for he spoke to lead you astray from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, who redeemed you from slavery, to drive you out from the way in which the Lord your God commanded you to walk; and you shall eliminate the wicked person from among yourselves.
verses.13:7: Now if your brother from your father or from your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife who is in your bosom, or a friend who is equal to your soul, urges you secretly, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods," whom you and your fathers did not know,
verses.13:8: from the gods of the nations around you, those near to you or those far from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth,
verses.13:9: you shall not consent to him, and you shall not listen to him, and your eye shall not spare him; you shall not long for him, nor shall you in any way conceal him.
verses.13:10: You shall surely report about him; your hands shall be upon him first to kill him, and the hands of all the people afterward;
verses.13:11: and they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, because he sought to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.13:12: And all Israel will hear and be afraid, and will not again act according to this wicked thing among you.
verses.13:13: Now if you hear in one of your cities, which the Lord your God is giving you to dwell there, people saying,
verses.13:14: "Lawless men have gone out from among you and have turned away all those who dwell in their land, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods,' whom you did not know,"
verses.13:15: then you shall inquire and investigate thoroughly; and look, the report is truly and clearly the case, this abomination has been done among you:
verses.13:16: you shall surely kill all those who dwell in that land by the slaughter of the sword; you shall utterly devote it to destruction and everything that is in it;
verses.13:17: and you shall gather all its plunder into its thoroughfares, and burn the city with fire and all its plunder publicly before the Lord your God; and it shall be uninhabited forever, it shall not be rebuilt again.
verses.13:18: And nothing from what is devoted to destruction shall cling to your hand, so that the Lord may turn away from the fury of His anger; and He will grant you mercy and have mercy on you and multiply you, just as He swore to your fathers,
verses.13:19: if you listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments, all that I command you today, to do what is pleasing and good before the Lord your God.
verses.14:1: You are sons of the Lord your God; you shall not make a bald spot between your eyes for a dead person,
verses.14:2: for you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord your God chose you to become a special people for Himself out of all the nations that are on the face of the earth.
verses.14:3: You shall not eat any abomination.
verses.14:4: These are the animals that you may eat: a calf from the cattle, and a lamb from the sheep, and a kid from the goats,
verses.14:5: a deer, and a gazelle, and a pygarg, an oryx, and a giraffe.
verses.14:6: Every animal that divides the hoof and splits clefts of two hooves and brings up the cud among the animals, these you may eat.
verses.14:7: And these you shall not eat from among those that bring up the cud and from among those that divide the hooves and split clefts: the camel, and the hare, and the rock hyrax; because they bring up the cud and do not divide the hoof, these are unclean to you.
verses.14:8: And the pig, because it divides the hoof and splits clefts of the hoof, yet it does not chew the cud, it is unclean to you; you shall not eat from their flesh, you shall not touch their carcasses.
verses.14:9: And these you may eat from all that are in the water: everything that has fins and scales you may eat.
verses.14:10: And everything that does not have fins and scales you shall not eat; they are unclean to you.
verses.14:11: Every clean bird you may eat.
verses.14:12: And these from among them you shall not eat: the eagle, and the bearded vulture, and the sea eagle,
verses.14:13: and the vulture, and the kite and those like it,
verses.14:15: and the ostrich, and the owl, and the gull,
verses.14:16: and the heron, and the swan, and the ibis,
verses.14:17: and the cormorant, and the hawk and those like it, and the hoopoe, and the night raven,
verses.14:18: and the pelican, and the plover and those like it, and the purple gallinule, and the bat.
verses.14:19: All creeping winged creatures are unclean to you; you shall not eat of them.
verses.14:20: Every clean winged creature you may eat.
verses.14:21: You shall not eat any carcass; it shall be given to the resident alien who is in your cities, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to the foreigner; for you are a holy people to the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in the milk of its mother.
verses.14:22: You shall surely tithe all the produce of your seed, the produce of your field year by year,
verses.14:23: and you shall eat it in the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there; you shall bring the tithes of your grain and of your wine and of your oil, the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep, so that you may learn to fear the Lord your God all the days.
verses.14:24: Now if the way is far from you and you are unable to carry them up, because the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there is far from you, because the Lord your God will bless you,
verses.14:25: then you shall sell them for silver, and you shall take the silver in your hands and go to the place that the Lord your God chooses;
verses.14:26: and you shall spend silver on everything that your soul desires; and you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your son,
verses.14:27: and the Levite who is in your cities, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.14:28: After three years you shall bring out the entire tithe of your produce. In that year you shall place it in your cities.
verses.14:29: And the Levite shall come, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, and the resident alien, and the orphan, and the widow who is in your cities, and they shall eat and be filled, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works that you do.
verses.15:1: Every seven years you shall grant a release.
verses.15:2: And thus is the ordinance of the release: you shall release every personal debt that your neighbor owes you, and you shall not demand payment from your brother, for the release has been proclaimed to the Lord your God.
verses.15:3: From the foreigner you shall demand whatever is yours with him; to your brother you shall grant a release of your debt,
verses.15:4: because there will be no needy person among you, for the Lord your God will surely bless you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance for you to possess,
verses.15:5: if you diligently listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and to do all these commandments that I command you today.
verses.15:6: For the Lord your God has blessed you just as He spoke to you, and you will lend to many nations, yet you will not borrow; and you will rule over many nations, yet they will not rule over you.
verses.15:7: Now if there is a needy person among you from your brothers, in one of your cities in the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not turn your heart away, nor shall you in any way clench your hand from your needy brother;
verses.15:8: you shall surely open your hands to him; you shall surely lend him a loan for as much as he needs, according to what he lacks.
verses.15:9: Watch yourself so that a hidden word does not arise in your heart, a lawless thing, saying, "The seventh year is drawing near, the year of release," and your eye becomes evil toward your needy brother, and you do not give to him; and he will cry out against you to the Lord, and there will be a great sin in you.
verses.15:10: You shall surely give to him, you shall surely lend him a loan for as much as he needs, according to what he lacks; and you shall not be grieved in your heart when you give to him, because on account of this thing the Lord your God will bless you in all the works and in everything to which you put your hand.
verses.15:11: For a needy person will never cease from the land; therefore I command you to do this thing, saying, "You shall surely open your hands to your brother, to the poor and to the needy one who is in your land."
verses.15:12: Now if your brother, the Hebrew man and the Hebrew woman, is sold to you, he shall serve you six years, and in the seventh you shall send him away free from you.
verses.15:13: And when you send him away free from you, you shall not send him away empty;
verses.15:14: you shall surely supply him with provisions from your sheep and from your grain and from your wine; just as the Lord your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
verses.15:15: And you shall remember that you were a household servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.15:16: Now if he says to you, "I will not go out from you," because he has loved you and your household, because it is well for him with you,
verses.15:17: then you shall take the awl and pierce his ear against the door, and he shall be your household servant forever; and to your female servant you shall do likewise.
verses.15:18: It shall not be hard before you when they are sent away free from you, because he served you six years for the annual wage of a hired worker; and the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.
verses.15:19: Every firstborn that is born among your cattle and among your sheep, the males you shall consecrate to the Lord your God; you shall not work with your firstborn calf, and you shall by no means shear the firstborn of your sheep;
verses.15:20: before the Lord you shall eat it year by year in the place that the Lord your God chooses, you and your household.
verses.15:21: And if there is a blemish in it, lame or blind, a bad blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God;
verses.15:22: in your cities you shall eat it; the unclean person among you and the clean person alike shall eat it, like a gazelle or a deer;
verses.15:23: only you shall not eat blood; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.16:1: Observe the month of new produce, and you shall keep the Passover to the Lord your God, because in the month of new produce you came out of Egypt by night.
verses.16:2: And you shall sacrifice the Passover to the Lord your God, sheep and cattle, in the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there.
verses.16:3: You shall not eat leaven with it; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, bread of affliction, because you came out of Egypt in haste, so that you may remember the day of your departure from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.16:4: Leaven shall not be seen with you within all your borders for seven days, and none of the meat that you sacrifice in the evening on the first day shall remain overnight until morning.
verses.16:5: You may not sacrifice the Passover in any of your cities that the Lord your God is giving you,
verses.16:6: but only at the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there; you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening toward sunset, at the time when you came out of Egypt.
verses.16:7: And you shall boil and roast and eat in the place that the Lord your God chooses; and in the morning you shall turn back and go to your houses.
verses.16:8: For six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there is a closing assembly, a festival to the Lord your God; you shall not do any work on it, except whatever is to be done for a person.
verses.16:9: You shall count out seven weeks for yourself; from when you begin with the sickle in the harvest, you shall begin to count out seven weeks.
verses.16:10: And you shall keep the Festival of Weeks to the Lord your God according to what your hand is able, as much as the Lord your God gives.
verses.16:11: And you shall rejoice before your God, and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite and the resident alien and the orphan and the widow who is among you, in the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there.
verses.16:12: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and you shall keep and do these commandments.
verses.16:13: You shall keep the Festival of Tents for yourself for seven days when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
verses.16:14: And you shall rejoice in your festival, you and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite and the resident alien and the orphan and the widow who is in your cities.
verses.16:15: For seven days you shall celebrate a festival to the Lord your God in the place that the Lord your God chooses for Himself; and if the Lord your God blesses you in all your produce and in every work of your hands, then you shall be rejoicing.
verses.16:16: Three times a year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord chooses: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and at the Festival of Weeks, and at the Festival of Tent-Pitching. You shall not appear before the Lord your God empty-handed;
verses.16:17: each one according to the ability of your hands, according to the blessing of the Lord your God that He has given you.
verses.16:18: You shall appoint judges and recorders for yourself in your cities that the Lord your God is giving you, tribe by tribe, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
verses.16:19: They shall not show partiality, nor shall they accept a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise and will remove the words of the righteous.
verses.16:20: Justly you shall pursue what is just, so that you may live and enter and inherit the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.16:21: You shall not plant a sacred grove for yourself; you shall not make any tree for yourself beside the altar of your God.
verses.16:22: You shall not set up a pillar for yourself, things that the Lord your God hates.
verses.17:1: You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God a calf or a sheep in which there is a blemish, any bad thing, because it is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.17:2: Now if there is found in one of your cities that the Lord your God is giving you a man or a woman who does what is evil before the Lord your God, transgressing His covenant,
verses.17:3: and they go and serve other gods and bow down to them—to the sun or the moon or anything from the array of heaven, things which He did not command—
verses.17:4: and it is reported to you, then you shall inquire thoroughly; and look, the matter has truly happened, this abomination has occurred in Israel;
verses.17:5: and you shall take out that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
verses.17:6: On the basis of two witnesses or on the basis of three witnesses, the one who is to die shall die; he shall not die on the basis of one witness.
verses.17:7: And the hand of the witnesses shall be against him first to put him to death, and the hand of the people afterward; and you shall remove the evil person from among yourselves.
verses.17:8: Now if a matter in judgment is too difficult for you—between blood and blood, and between judgment and judgment, and between assault and assault, and between dispute and dispute, matters of judgment in your cities—then you shall arise and go up to the place that the Lord your God chooses there,
verses.17:9: and you shall come to the judge who arises in those days, and they will inquire and declare the judgment to you.
verses.17:10: And you shall do according to the matter that they declare to you from the place that the Lord your God chooses, and you shall be careful to do all that is legislated for you.
