verses.17:11: According to the law and according to the judgment that they tell you, you shall act; you shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you, to the right or to the left.
verses.17:12: And the person who acts in arrogance so as not to obey the priest who stands to minister in the name of the Lord your God, or the judge who is there in those days—that person shall die, and you shall remove the evil person from Israel.
verses.17:13: And all the people will hear and fear, and will not act impiously anymore.
verses.17:14: Now if you enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and inherit it and dwell upon it, and say, "I will appoint a ruler over myself, just like the rest of the nations around me,"
verses.17:15: you shall surely appoint over yourself a ruler whom the Lord God chooses. From among your brothers you shall appoint a ruler over yourself; you may not appoint a foreign man over yourself, because he is not your brother.
verses.17:16: For he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor shall he turn the people back to Egypt, so that he does not multiply horses for himself; and the Lord said, "You shall never again return by this way."
verses.17:17: And he shall not multiply wives for himself, nor shall his heart turn away; and he shall not greatly multiply silver and gold for himself.
verses.17:18: And when he is seated over his rule, he shall write for himself this second law in a book from the priests, the Levites,
verses.17:19: and it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the Lord your God and to keep all these commandments and to do these statutes,
verses.17:20: so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, so that he may not depart from the commandments to the right or to the left, in order that he may continue long over his rule, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
verses.18:1: The priests, the Levites—the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel; the offerings of the Lord are their inheritance; they shall eat them.
verses.18:2: And they shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the Lord Himself is his inheritance, just as He said to him.
verses.18:3: And this is the due right of the priests—the things from the people, from those sacrificing the sacrifices, whether a calf or a sheep: he shall give to the priest the shoulder and the cheeks and the stomach.
verses.18:4: And the firstfruits of your grain and your wine and your oil, and the firstfruit of the shearings of your sheep, you shall give to him;
verses.18:5: because the Lord chose him out of all your tribes to stand before the Lord God, to minister and to bless in His name, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
verses.18:6: Now if the Levite comes from one of the cities from among all the sons of Israel where he lives as a resident alien, just as his soul desires, to the place that He chooses,
verses.18:7: he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God just like all his brothers the Levites who stand there before the Lord your God.
verses.18:8: He shall eat an apportioned portion, apart from the sale according to paternal family.
verses.18:9: Now when you enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you shall not learn to act according to the abominations of those nations.
verses.18:10: There shall not be found among you one who purifies his son and his daughter by fire, one who practices divination, one who observes omens and practices augury, one who with charms
verses.18:11: chants an incantation, a medium and an observer of portents, one who inquires of the dead.
verses.18:12: For everyone who does these things is an abomination to the Lord your God; for on account of these abominations the Lord will utterly destroy them away from you.
verses.18:13: You shall be perfect before the Lord your God.
verses.18:14: For these nations that you are dispossessing—they will listen to omens and divinations; but to you the Lord your God has not given it this way.
verses.18:15: A prophet from among your brothers like me the Lord your God will raise up for you; to him you shall listen;
verses.18:16: according to all that you asked from the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, "We will not hear the voice of the Lord your God again, and we will not see this great fire anymore, nor shall we die."
verses.18:17: And the Lord said to me, "Everything that they have spoken to you is right;
verses.18:18: I will raise up a prophet for them from among their brothers like you, and I will put My words in his mouth, and he will speak to them just as I command him.
verses.18:19: And the person who does not listen to whatever that prophet speaks in My name—I Myself will exact retribution from him.
verses.18:20: However, the prophet who acts impiously to speak a word in My name that I did not command to speak, and who speaks in the name of other gods—that prophet shall die."
verses.18:21: And if you say in your heart, "How will we know the word that the Lord has not spoken?"
verses.18:22: Whatever that prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, and it does not happen and does not come about, this is the word that the Lord has not spoken; that prophet has spoken in impiety; you shall not spare him.
verses.19:1: Now when the Lord your God wipes out the nations whose land God is giving you, and you take possession of them and live in their cities and in their houses,
verses.19:2: you shall set apart three cities for yourself in the middle of your land, which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.19:3: Measure out the road for yourself, and divide into three parts the territory of your land which the Lord your God is apportioning to you, and there shall be a refuge there for every killer.
verses.19:4: Now this shall be the ordinance for the killer who flees there and will live: whoever strikes his neighbor unknowingly, and did not hate him in the past,
verses.19:5: and whoever goes with his neighbor into the forest to gather wood, and his hand swings out with the axe as he cuts the wood, and the iron head slips off the wood and hits his neighbor, and he dies—this person shall flee for refuge to one of these cities and live,
verses.19:6: so that the kinsman-avenger of blood does not pursue after the one who killed, because his heart is inflamed, and overtake him if the road is too long, and strike him fatally—yet for this person there is no sentence of death, because he had not hated him in the past.
verses.19:7: Therefore I am commanding you this word, saying, "You shall set apart three cities for yourself."
verses.19:8: Now if the Lord your God enlarges your territory, just as He swore to your fathers, and the Lord gives you all the land that He said He would give to your fathers,
verses.19:9: if you listen so as to do all these commandments which I am commanding you today, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways all the days, then you shall add three more cities for yourself in addition to these three,
verses.19:10: and innocent blood shall not be shed in the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an allotment, and there shall not be among you anyone guilty of blood.
verses.19:11: But if there is among you a man who hates his neighbor, and lies in ambush for him, and rises up against him and strikes him fatally so that he dies, and flees to one of these cities,
verses.19:12: then the council of elders of his city shall send and take him from there, and deliver him into the hands of the kinsman-avengers of blood, and he shall die.
verses.19:13: Your eye shall not spare him, and you shall cleanse away the innocent blood from Israel, and it shall go well with you.
verses.19:14: You shall not move a neighbor's boundaries, which your fathers set, in the inheritance that you have inherited in the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an allotment.
verses.19:15: A single witness shall not stand to testify against a person for any injustice, or for any offense, or for any sin that he may commit; by the mouth of two witnesses and by the mouth of three witnesses every matter shall stand.
verses.19:16: Now if an unjust witness comes forward against a person, accusing him of ungodliness,
verses.19:17: then the two people who have the dispute shall know before the Lord, and before the priests and before the judges who are in place in those days;
verses.19:18: and the judges shall investigate thoroughly, and look, an unjust witness testified unjustly; he stood against his brother;
verses.19:19: and you shall do to him just as he plotted with evil intent to do against his brother, and you shall remove the evil person from among yourselves.
verses.19:20: And the rest shall hear and be afraid, and they shall not again act according to this evil thing among you.
verses.19:21: Your eye shall not spare him: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.20:1: Now when you go out to war against your enemies and see horse and rider and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them, because the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:2: And it shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall come forward and speak to the people,
verses.20:3: and he shall say to them, "Listen, Israel: you are going today into battle against your enemies. Do not let your heart grow faint; do not be afraid, nor be broken, nor turn aside from before them,
verses.20:4: because it is the Lord your God who goes ahead with you, to fight your enemies together with you, to save you."
verses.20:5: And the scribes shall speak to the people, saying, "Who is the man who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, or else he may die in the battle and another man will dedicate it.
verses.20:6: And who is the man who has planted a vineyard and has not taken enjoyment from it? Let him go and return to his house, or else he may die in the battle and another man will take enjoyment from it.
verses.20:7: And who is the man who is engaged to a woman and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, or else he may die in the battle and another man will take her."
verses.20:8: And the scribes shall speak further to the people and say, "Who is the man who is fearful and cowardly in heart? Let him go and return to his house, so that he does not make his brother's heart cowardly like his own."
verses.20:9: And it shall be, when the scribes finish speaking to the people, that they shall appoint commanders of the army to lead the people.
verses.20:10: Now when you approach a city to make war against them, call them out with peace.
verses.20:11: If they answer you peacefully and open to you, then all the people who are found in it shall be under tribute to you and subject to you;
verses.20:12: but if they do not obey you and make war against you, you shall besiege it,
verses.20:13: until the Lord your God delivers it into your hands, and you shall strike down every male of it with the slaughter of the sword,
verses.20:14: except the women and the dependents; and whatever is in the city and all the movable goods you shall plunder for yourself, and you shall eat all the plunder of your enemies whom the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.20:15: In this way you shall treat all the cities that are very far away from you, not from the cities of these nations
verses.20:16: whose land the Lord your God is giving you to inherit; you shall not keep alive anything that breathes,
verses.20:17: rather, you shall utterly devote them to destruction—the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—just as the Lord your God commanded you,
verses.20:18: so that they do not teach you to do all their abominations that they have done for their gods, and you sin before the Lord your God.
verses.20:19: Now when you besiege one city for many days, to make war against it for its capture, you shall not destroy its trees by putting iron to them; rather, you may eat from it, but you shall not cut it down. Is the tree in the field a human being, that it should enter the siegework from before you?
verses.20:20: However, a tree that you know does not bear edible fruit—this you shall destroy and cut down, and you shall build siegeworks against the city that is making war against you, until it is delivered up.
verses.21:1: Now if someone struck down is found in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, fallen in the open field, and they do not know the one who struck him,
verses.21:2: your council of elders and your judges shall go out and measure out to the cities that are around the person struck down,
verses.21:3: and it shall be the city that is nearest to the person struck down: the council of elders of that city shall take a heifer from the cattle, which has not been worked and which has not pulled a yoke;
verses.21:4: and the council of elders of that city shall bring the heifer down into a rough ravine, which has not been worked nor is sown, and they shall hamstring the heifer in the ravine.
verses.21:5: And the priests, the Levites, shall come forward, because the Lord God chose them to stand before Him and to bless in His name, and by their mouth shall be every dispute and every assault.
verses.21:6: And the entire council of elders of that city, those who are nearest to the person struck down, shall wash their hands over the head of the heifer that was hamstrung in the ravine,
verses.21:7: and they shall answer and say, "Our hands did not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen.
verses.21:8: Be merciful to Your people Israel, whom You redeemed, Lord, so that innocent blood may not be among Your people Israel." And the blood shall be atoned for on their behalf.
verses.21:9: So you shall remove the innocent blood from among yourselves, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
verses.21:10: Now when you go out to war against your enemies, and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands, and you take their plunder,
verses.21:11: and you see among the plunder a woman beautiful in appearance, and you desire her and take her for yourself as a wife,
verses.21:12: then you shall bring her inside into your house, and you shall shave her head and trim her nails,
verses.21:13: and you shall remove the garments of captivity from her, and she shall sit in your house and weep for her father and her mother for a month of days; and after this you shall go in to her and be joined in marriage to her, and she shall be your wife.
verses.21:14: And it shall be, if you do not want her, you shall send her away free, and she shall certainly not be sold for silver; you shall not deal treacherously with her, because you have humbled her.
verses.21:15: Now if a man has two wives, one of them loved and one of them hated, and the loved one and the hated one give birth for him, and the firstborn son belongs to the hated one,
verses.21:16: then it shall be, on the day when he bequeaths his possessions to his sons, that he shall not be able to grant firstborn rights to the son of the loved one, overlooking the son of the hated one, the firstborn;
verses.21:17: rather, he shall acknowledge the firstborn son of the hated one by giving him a double portion of everything that is found belonging to him, because this one is the beginning of his children, and to him belong the rights of the firstborn.
verses.21:18: Now if someone has a disobedient and defiant son, not obeying the voice of his father and the voice of his mother, and they discipline him, yet he does not listen to them,
verses.21:19: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the council of elders of his city and to the gate of the place,
verses.21:20: and they shall say to the men of their city, "This son of ours disobeys and acts defiantly; he does not obey our voice; he carouses and drinks to excess."
verses.21:21: Then the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die; and you shall remove the evil person from among yourselves, and the rest shall hear and be afraid.
verses.21:22: Now if there is in someone a sin with a sentence of death, and he dies, and you hang him on a tree,
verses.21:23: his body shall not remain overnight on the tree; rather, you shall certainly bury it on that day, because everyone hanging on a tree is cursed by God; and you shall not defile the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an allotment.
verses.22:1: Do not see your brother's calf or his sheep straying on the road and overlook them; you shall surely bring them back to your brother and return them to him.
verses.22:2: And if your brother is not near you, or you do not know him, you shall gather it inside your house, and it shall be with you until your brother searches for them, and you shall return them to him.
verses.22:3: So you shall do with his donkey, and so you shall do with every lost thing of your brother; whatever may be lost from him that you find, you may not overlook it.
verses.22:4: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his calf fallen on the road and overlook them; you shall surely lift them up with him.
verses.22:5: Articles of a man shall not be on a woman, nor shall a man put on a woman's garment; for everyone who does these things is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.22:6: And if you come upon a nest of birds before you on the road, either in any tree or on the ground, with chicks or eggs, and the mother is brooding over the chicks or over the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young;
verses.22:7: you shall surely send the mother away, but you may take the young ones for yourself, so that it may go well with you and you may have many days.
verses.22:8: If you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof, and you shall not cause murder in your house if anyone who falls should fall from it.
verses.22:9: You shall not sow your vineyard for a double yield, so that the produce and the seed that someone may sow, together with the produce of your vineyard, may not be consecrated.
verses.22:10: You shall not plow with a calf and a donkey together.
verses.22:11: You shall not wear anything adulterated, wool and linen together.
verses.22:12: You shall make twisted cords for yourself on the four borders of your cloaks that you wrap around yourself.
verses.22:13: And if anyone takes a wife and lives with her, and hates her,
verses.22:14: and lays pretextual charges against her, and brings an evil name against her, and says, "I took this woman, and when I approached her, I did not find her signs of virginity,"
verses.22:15: then the father of the girl and the mother shall take and bring out the girl's signs of virginity to the council of elders at the gate.
verses.22:16: And the father of the girl shall say to the council of elders, "I gave this daughter of mine to this man as a wife, and having come to hate her,
verses.22:17: now this man lays pretextual charges against her, saying, 'I did not find signs of virginity in your daughter,' yet these are the signs of virginity of my daughter." And they shall spread out the garment before the council of elders of the city.
verses.22:18: And the council of elders of that city shall take that man and discipline him,
verses.22:19: and they shall fine him one hundred shekels and give them to the father of the young woman, because he brought out an evil name against an Israelite virgin; and she shall be his wife; he may not send her away for all time.
verses.22:20: But if this charge proves true, and signs of virginity are not found for the young woman,
verses.22:21: then they shall bring the young woman out to the doors of her father, and they shall stone her with stones, and she shall die, because she committed folly among the sons of Israel by prostituting her father's house; and you shall remove the evil person from among yourselves.
verses.22:22: And if a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, you shall put both of them to death, the man lying with the woman and the woman; and you shall remove the evil person from Israel.
verses.22:23: And if there is a virgin girl betrothed to a man, and a man finds her in a city and lies with her,
verses.22:24: you shall bring both of them out to the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones and die: the young woman, because she did not cry out in the city, and the man, because he humiliated his neighbor's wife; and you shall remove the evil person from among yourselves.
verses.22:25: But if a man finds the betrothed girl in open country and forces her and lies with her, you shall put to death only the one lying with her.
verses.22:26: And for the young woman there is no sin worthy of death. Just as if a man rises up against his neighbor and murders his life, so is this matter;
verses.22:27: for he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried out, and there was no one to help her.
verses.22:28: And if anyone finds a virgin girl who is not betrothed, and forces her and lies with her, and he is found out,
verses.22:29: the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the young woman fifty didrachmas of silver, and she shall be his wife, because he humiliated her; he may not send her away for all time.
verses.23:1: A man shall not take his father's wife, and he shall not uncover his father's covering.
verses.23:2: Neither one with crushed testicles nor one who is cut off shall enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.23:3: One born of a prostitute shall not enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.23:4: Neither an Ammonite nor a Moabite shall enter the assembly of the Lord; even to the tenth generation he shall not enter the assembly of the Lord, even forever,
verses.23:5: because they did not meet you with bread and water on the road as you were coming out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Mesopotamia to curse you;
verses.23:6: and the Lord your God was not willing to listen to Balaam, and the Lord your God turned the curses into a blessing, because the Lord your God loved you.
verses.23:7: You shall not speak peaceful things to them or beneficial things to them all your days forever.
verses.23:8: You shall not abhor an Idumean, because he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were a resident alien in his land.
verses.23:9: If sons are born to them, in the third generation they shall enter the assembly of the Lord.
verses.23:10: And if you go out to encamp against your enemies, then you shall guard yourself from every evil thing.
verses.23:11: If there is among you a man who is not clean from his discharge at night, then he shall go out into the camp.
verses.23:12: And it shall be toward evening that he shall wash his body with water, and when the sun has set, he shall enter the camp.
verses.23:13: And you shall have a place outside the camp, and you shall go outside there.
verses.23:14: And you shall have a peg on your belt, and it shall be, when you squat down outside, that you shall dig with it and cover over your indecency;
verses.23:15: for the Lord your God walks about in your camp to deliver you and to hand over your enemy before you; and your camp shall be holy, and no indecent thing shall be seen among you, or He will turn away from you.
verses.23:16: You shall not hand over to his master a servant who has attached himself to you from his master.
verses.23:17: He shall live with you, among you; he shall live wherever it pleases him; you shall not oppress him.
verses.23:18: There shall not be a prostitute from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a man practicing prostitution from the sons of Israel; there shall not be a ritual initiate from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be one being initiated from the sons of Israel.
verses.23:19: You shall not bring the wage of a prostitute or the exchange price of a dog into the house of the Lord your God for any vow, for both of them are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.23:20: You shall not charge your brother interest: interest on silver, or interest on food, or interest on anything that you may lend out.
verses.23:21: To a foreigner you may charge interest, but to your brother you shall not charge interest, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all your works in the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.23:22: And if you vow a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay to pay it, for the Lord your God will surely require it from you, and there will be sin in you.
verses.23:23: But if you do not wish to make a vow, there is no sin in you.
verses.23:24: You shall keep what goes out through your lips, and you shall do just as you vowed to God, a gift that you spoke with your mouth.
verses.23:25: And if you enter your neighbor's standing grain, you may gather heads of grain with your hands, but you shall not put a sickle to your neighbor's standing grain.
verses.23:26: And if you enter your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes as much as fills your appetite, but you shall not put any into a vessel.
verses.24:1: Now if someone takes a wife and lives with her, and it happens that she does not find favor before him because he found an indecent thing in her, and he writes her a document of divorce and puts it into her hands and sends her away from his house,
verses.24:2: and having departed she belongs to another man,
verses.24:3: and the latter husband hates her and writes her a document of divorce and puts it into her hands and sends her away from his house, and the latter husband who took her as a wife for himself dies,
verses.24:4: the former husband who sent her away will not be able to return and take her as a wife for himself after she has been defiled, for it is an abomination before the Lord your God; and you must not defile the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an allotment.
verses.24:5: Now if someone has recently taken a wife, he must not go out to war, and no duty will be imposed on him; he will be exempt in his house for one year; he will bring joy to his wife whom he has taken.
verses.24:6: You must not take a millstone or an upper millstone as a pledge, for that person takes a life as a pledge.
verses.24:7: Now if a man is caught stealing a person from his brothers, the sons of Israel, and after overpowering him sells him, that thief must die; and you will remove the evil person from among yourselves.
verses.24:8: Watch yourself regarding the plague of leprosy; be very careful to act according to all the law that the priests, the Levites, declare to you; in the way I commanded you, be careful to act.
verses.24:9: Remember all that the Lord your God did to Miriam on the way, as you were coming out of Egypt.
verses.24:10: If there is a debt against your neighbor, any debt at all, and you go into his house to take his pledge,
verses.24:11: you must stand outside, and the man who owes your loan will bring the pledge outside to you.
verses.24:12: And if the man is poor, you must not sleep in the pledge;
verses.24:13: you must certainly return his pledge by sunset, and he will sleep in his cloak and bless you, and it will be mercy for you before the Lord your God.
verses.24:14: You must not unjustly withhold the wage of a poor and needy person from among your brothers or from among the resident aliens who are in your cities;
verses.24:15: on the same day you must pay his wage; the sun must not go down on it, for he is poor and has his hope in it, and he will cry out against you to the Lord, and there will be sin in you.
verses.24:16: Fathers must not die for children, and sons must not die for fathers; each person will die in his own sin.
verses.24:17: You must not pervert the justice of a resident alien, an orphan, and a widow,
verses.24:18: because you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; for this reason I command you to do this thing.
verses.24:19: Now if you reap a harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in your field, you must not turn back to take it; it will be for the resident alien, the orphan, and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works of your hands.
verses.24:20: And if you gather olives, you must not go back to glean what is behind you; it will be for the resident alien, the orphan, and the widow; and you will remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; for this reason I command you to do this thing.
verses.24:21: And if you harvest your vineyard, you must not re-harvest it for what is behind you; it will be for the resident alien, the orphan, and the widow;
verses.24:22: and you will remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; for this reason I command you to do this thing.
verses.25:1: Now if a dispute arises between people, and they come forward for judgment, and they vindicate what is right and condemn the ungodly person,
verses.25:2: then it will be that if the one acting ungodly deserves blows, you must seat him before them.
verses.25:3: And by the number of forty they will flog him; they must not add to it; but if you proceed to flog with more blows beyond these, your brother will be disgraced before you.
verses.25:4: You must not muzzle a threshing ox.
verses.25:5: Now if brothers live together, and one of them dies, and he had no seed, the wife of the deceased man must not belong outside to a man who is not a close relative; her husband's brother will go in to her and take her as a wife for himself and live with her.
verses.25:6: And it will be that the child whom she bears will be established by the name of the deceased, and his name will not be blotted out from Israel.
verses.25:7: But if the man does not wish to take his brother's wife, then the woman will go up to the gate, to the council of elders, and say, "My husband's brother is not willing to raise up his brother's name in Israel; my husband's brother was not willing."
verses.25:8: And the council of elders of his city will summon him and speak to him, and if he stands and says, "I do not wish to take her,"
verses.25:9: then his brother's wife, coming forward before the council of elders, will untie his one sandal from his foot and spit in his face, and answering she will say, "In this way they will do to the man who will not build his brother's house in Israel."
verses.25:10: And his name will be called in Israel, "House of the One Whose Sandal Was Untied."
verses.25:11: Now if men fight together, a man with his brother, and the wife of one of them comes near to rescue her husband from the hand of the one striking him, and stretching out her hand she seizes his testicles,
verses.25:12: you must cut off her hand; your eye must not spare her.
verses.25:13: You must not have in your bag a weight and a weight, a large or a small;
verses.25:14: there must not be in your house a measure and a measure, a large or a small;
verses.25:15: you must have a true and just weight, so that you may live many days on the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an allotment.
verses.25:16: For everyone who does these things, everyone who does what is unjust, is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.25:17: Remember all that Amalek did to you on the way as you were coming out of the land of Egypt,
verses.25:18: how he opposed you on the way and cut off your rear guard, those who were weary behind you, while you were hungry and weary, and he did not fear God;
verses.25:19: and it will be that when the Lord your God gives you rest from all your enemies around you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, you must blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven, and you must never forget.
verses.26:1: And it will be that when you enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, and take possession of it and live on it,
verses.26:2: then you must take from the firstfruits of the fruits of your land that the Lord your God is giving you, and put them into a basket, and go to the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there;
verses.26:3: and you must come to the priest who will be in those days and say to him, "I declare today to the Lord my God that I have entered the land that the Lord swore to our fathers to give us."
verses.26:4: And the priest will take the basket from your hands and set it in front of the altar of the Lord your God;
verses.26:5: and answering he will say before the Lord your God, "My father abandoned Syria and went down to Egypt, and lived there as a foreigner with a small number, and became there a great nation and a large multitude.
verses.26:6: And the Egyptians mistreated us and humbled us and laid harsh labors upon us;
verses.26:7: and we cried out to the Lord our God, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our humiliation and our oppression;
verses.26:8: and the Lord brought us out of Egypt, He Himself with His great strength and with a mighty hand and a raised arm, and with great visions and with signs and with wonders;
verses.26:9: and He brought us into this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.26:10: And now, look, I have brought the firstfruits of the produce of the land that You gave me, Lord, a land flowing with milk and honey." And you will bow down before the Lord your God;
verses.26:11: and you will rejoice in all the good things that the Lord your God has given you, along with your household, the Levite, and the resident alien who is among you.
verses.26:12: Now when you finish tithing the entire tithe of your produce in the third year, you must give the second tithe to the Levite, the resident alien, the orphan, and the widow, and they will eat in your cities and rejoice.
verses.26:13: And you will say before the Lord your God, "I have cleared out the holy things from my house and given them to the Levite, the resident alien, the orphan, and the widow, according to all the commandments that You commanded me; I have not transgressed Your commandment, and I have not forgotten;
verses.26:14: and I have not eaten any of them in my grief, I have not offered any of them for what is unclean, I have not given any of them to the dead; I have obeyed the voice of the Lord our God; I have obeyed just as You commanded me.
verses.26:15: Look down from Your holy house, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land that You gave them, just as You swore to our fathers to give us a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.26:16: On this day the Lord your God has commanded you to do all the statutes and the judgments; and you must keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.26:17: You have chosen God today to be your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to keep the statutes and the judgments, and to obey His voice;
verses.26:18: and the Lord has chosen you today for you to become a treasured people for Him, just as He said, to keep His commandments,
verses.26:19: and for you to be above all the nations, as He made you renowned and a boast and honored, for you to be a holy people to the Lord your God, just as He spoke.
verses.27:1: And Moses and the council of elders of the Israelites commanded, "Observe all these commandments that I am commanding you today.
verses.27:2: And it will be, on the day when you cross the Jordan into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, that you shall set up for yourself large stones and coat them with plaster.
verses.27:3: And you shall write on these stones all the words of this law when you cross the Jordan, at the time you enter the land that the Lord God of your fathers is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord God of your fathers spoke to you.
verses.27:4: And it will be, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I am commanding you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
verses.27:5: And you shall build an altar there to the Lord your God, an altar of stones; you shall not lay iron on it.
verses.27:6: With whole stones you shall build an altar to the Lord your God, and you shall offer up on it the burnt offerings to the Lord your God.
verses.27:7: And you shall sacrifice there a sacrifice of deliverance, and you shall eat and be filled and rejoice before the Lord your God.
verses.27:8: And you shall write on the stones all this law very clearly."
verses.27:9: And Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying, "Be silent and listen, Israel. On this day you have become a people for the Lord your God.
verses.27:10: And you shall obey the voice of the Lord your God, and you shall do all His commandments and His statutes that I am commanding you today."
verses.27:11: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,
verses.27:12: "These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim after crossing the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.27:13: And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad and Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali."
verses.27:14: And the Levites shall answer and say to all Israel with a loud voice:
verses.27:15: "Cursed is a person who makes a carved and cast image, an abomination to the Lord, the work of the hands of craftsmen, and sets it in a secret place." And the people shall answer and say, "So be it."
verses.27:16: "Cursed is the one who dishonors his father or his mother." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:17: "Cursed is the one who moves the boundaries of a neighbor." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:18: "Cursed is the one who leads a blind person astray on the road." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:19: "Cursed is whoever perverts the justice of a resident alien, an orphan, and a widow." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:20: "Cursed is the one who lies with a wife of his father, because he uncovered his father's covering." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:21: "Cursed is the one who lies with any animal." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:22: "Cursed is the one who lies with a sister of his father or his mother." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:23: "Cursed is the one who lies with his daughter-in-law." And all the people shall say, "So be it." "Cursed is the one who lies with his wife's sister." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:24: "Cursed is the one who strikes his neighbor by treachery." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:25: "Cursed is whoever takes bribes to strike down a life of innocent blood." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:26: "Cursed is every person who does not remain in all the words of this law to do them." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.28:1: And it will be, if you indeed listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and to do all these commandments that I am commanding you today, then the Lord your God will place you high over all the nations of the earth.
verses.28:2: And all these blessings will come upon you and find you, if you indeed listen to the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.28:3: Blessed are you in the city, and blessed are you in the field.
verses.28:4: Blessed are the offspring of your womb, the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.28:5: Blessed are your storehouses and your reserves.
verses.28:6: Blessed are you in your coming in, and blessed are you in your going out.
verses.28:7: May the Lord your God hand over your enemies who stand against you, shattered before your face; by one way they will come out against you, and by seven ways they will flee from your presence.
verses.28:8: May the Lord send the blessing upon you in your storerooms and upon everything to which you put your hand, on the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.28:9: May the Lord raise you up for Himself as a holy people, just as He swore to your fathers, if you listen to the voice of the Lord your God and walk in all His ways.
verses.28:10: And all the nations of the earth will see you, that the name of the Lord has been called upon you, and they will fear you.
verses.28:11: And the Lord your God will multiply you for good things in the offspring of your womb, and in the produce of your land, and in the offspring of your livestock, on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.28:12: May the Lord open for you His good treasury, the sky, to give the rain to your land in season, to bless all the works of your hands; and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.
verses.28:13: May the Lord your God appoint you as head and not as tail, and you will then be above and will not be below, if you listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep all that I am commanding you today.
verses.28:14: You will not turn aside from any of the commandments that I am commanding you today, to the right or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.28:15: And it will be, if you do not heed the voice of the Lord your God, to keep all His commandments that I am commanding you today, then all these curses will come upon you and overtake you.
verses.28:16: Cursed are you in the city, and cursed are you in the field.
verses.28:17: Cursed are your storehouses and your reserves.
verses.28:18: Cursed are the offspring of your womb and the produce of your land, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.28:19: Cursed are you in your going out, and cursed are you in your coming in.
verses.28:20: May the Lord send upon you scarcity and starvation and consumption, upon everything to which you put your hand, until He exterminates you, and until He destroys you quickly, on account of your evil practices, because you forsook Me.
verses.28:21: May the Lord make death cling to you until He completely consumes you from the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.28:22: May the Lord strike you with distress and fever and chill and inflammation and wind-blight and mildew, and they will pursue you until they destroy you.
verses.28:23: And the sky over your head will be bronze to you, and the earth below you iron.
verses.28:24: May the Lord your God make the rain for your land dust, and loose earth will come down from the sky, until He wipes you out and until He destroys you quickly.
verses.28:25: May the Lord give you over to visitation before the enemies; by one way you will go out against them, and by seven ways you will flee from their presence, and you will be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.28:26: And your dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the wild beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
verses.28:27: May the Lord strike you with an Egyptian ulcer on the buttocks, and with fierce scab and itch, so that you cannot be healed.
verses.28:28: May the Lord strike you with derangement of blindness and with bewilderment of mind.
verses.28:29: And you will be groping at midday, as if a blind person were to grope in the darkness, and He will not prosper your ways; and you will then be wronged and plundered all the days, and there will be no one to help.
verses.28:30: You will take a wife, and another man will have her; you will build a house, and you will not live in it; you will plant a vineyard, and you will not harvest it.
verses.28:31: Your calf will be slaughtered before you, and you will not eat from it; your donkey will be snatched away from you, and will not be given back to you; your sheep will be given to your enemies,
verses.28:32: and your eyes will look at them, wasting away; your hand will have no strength.
verses.28:33: A nation that you do not know will eat the crops of your land and all your labors, and you will be wronged and crushed all the days.
verses.28:34: And you will be deranged because of the sights of your eyes that you will see.
verses.28:35: May the Lord strike you with a malignant ulcer on the knees and on the shins, so that you cannot be healed, from the sole of your feet to the crown of your head.
verses.28:36: May the Lord lead you away, and your rulers whom you appoint over yourself, to a nation that you and your fathers do not know, and there you will serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.28:37: And there you will be a riddle and a proverb and a tale among all the nations to which the Lord may lead you away.
verses.28:38: You will carry much seed out into the open field, and you will bring in little, because the locust will devour it.
verses.28:39: You will plant a vineyard and cultivate it, and you will not drink wine nor be gladdened from it, because the worm will devour it.
verses.28:40: You will have olive trees in all your borders, and you will not anoint yourself with oil, because your olives will drop off.
verses.28:41: You will father sons and daughters, and they will not be; for they will go away in captivity.
verses.28:42: The blight will completely consume all your wooden things and the produce of your land.
verses.28:43: The resident alien who is among you will go up higher and higher, but you will go down lower and lower.
verses.28:44: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him; he will be head, but you will be tail.
verses.28:45: And all these curses will come upon you and pursue you and overtake you, until He exterminates you and until He destroys you, because you did not heed the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and the statutes that He commanded you.
verses.28:46: And there will be signs and wonders in you, in your seed forever,
verses.28:47: because you did not serve the Lord your God with gladness and a good mind on account of the abundance of all things.
verses.28:48: And you will serve your enemies, whom the Lord will send upon you, in hunger and in the lack of all things; and He will put an iron collar on your neck, until He exterminates you.
verses.28:49: The Lord will bring upon you a nation from afar, from the end of the earth, like the swoop of an eagle, a nation whose voice you will not understand,
verses.28:50: a nation shameless in face, which will not respect the face of an old man and will not show mercy to a young man.
verses.28:51: And it will devour the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land, so as not to leave you grain, wine, oil, the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep, until it destroys you
verses.28:52: and wipes you out in your cities, until the high and fortified walls in which you have trusted are torn down in all your land; and it will afflict you in your cities that He gave you.
verses.28:53: And you will eat the offspring of your womb, the flesh of your sons and your daughters, all whom He gave you, in your distress and in your affliction, with which your enemy will afflict you.
verses.28:54: The tender and very delicate man among you will begrudge with his eye his brother and the wife in his embrace and the remaining children who may be left,
verses.28:55: so as not to give to any one of them from the flesh of his children whom he eats, because nothing has been left to him in your distress and in your affliction, with which your enemies will afflict you in all your cities.
verses.28:56: And the tender and delicate woman among you, whose foot has not ventured to step on the ground because of her delicacy, will begrudge with her eye her husband in her embrace and her son and her daughter,
verses.28:57: and her afterbirth that comes out from between her thighs and the child that she may bear; for she will devour them secretly on account of the scarcity of all things, in your distress and in your affliction, with which your enemy will afflict you in your cities.
verses.28:58: If you do not listen to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, to fear this honored, wondrous name, the Lord your God,
verses.28:59: then the Lord will make extraordinary your plagues and the plagues of your seed, great and wondrous plagues, and malignant and lasting diseases.
verses.28:60: And He will bring back all the malignant suffering of Egypt, which you dreaded before them, and they will cling to you.
verses.28:61: And the Lord will bring upon you every sickness and every plague that is not written in the book of this law, until He exterminates you.
verses.28:62: And you will be left in a small number, whereas you were like the stars of the sky in multitude, because you did not heed the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.28:63: And it will be, just as the Lord rejoiced over you to do good to you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to exterminate you; and you will be removed quickly from the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.28:64: And the Lord your God will scatter you into all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth, and there you will serve other gods, wood and stone, whom you and your fathers did not know.
verses.28:65: Yet even among those nations He will not give you rest, nor will there ever be a standing place for the sole of your foot; and there the Lord will give you a different, disobedient heart, and failing eyes, and a melting soul.
verses.28:66: And your life will be hanging in front of your eyes, and you will be afraid day and night, and you will not trust in your life.
verses.28:67: In the morning you will say, "If only evening would come!" and in the evening you will say, "If only morning would come!" because of the fear of your heart that you will fear, and because of the sights of your eyes that you will see.
verses.28:68: And the Lord will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said, "You will never see it again"; and there you will be sold to your enemies as male servants and female servants, and there will be no one to buy.
verses.28:69: These are the words of the covenant that the Lord commanded Moses to establish with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that He made with them at Horeb.
verses.29:1: And Moses called all the sons of Israel and said to them, "You have seen all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt before you to Pharaoh and to his attendants and to all his land,
verses.29:2: the great trials which your eyes have seen, those great signs and wonders.
verses.29:3: Yet the Lord God has not given you a heart to know and eyes to see and ears to hear up to this day.
verses.29:4: And He led you in the wilderness forty years; your garments did not grow old, and your sandals did not wear out from your feet.
verses.29:5: You did not eat bread; you did not drink wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.29:6: And you came as far as this place, and Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to meet you in battle;
verses.29:7: and we struck them down, and we took their land, and I gave it as an inheritance to Reuben and to Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.29:8: And you shall be careful to do all the words of this covenant, so that you may understand all that you will do.
verses.29:9: You are all standing today before the Lord your God: your tribal leaders and your council of elders and your judges and your recorders, every man of Israel,
verses.29:10: your wives and your offspring and the resident alien who is in the midst of your camp, from your woodcutter even to your water-carrier,
verses.29:11: to enter into the covenant of the Lord your God and into His curses, all that the Lord your God is making with you today,
verses.29:12: so that He may establish you for Himself as a people, and He Himself will be your God, just as He spoke to you and just as He swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.
verses.29:13: And not with you alone am I making this covenant and this curse,
verses.29:14: but both with those who are here with us today before the Lord your God, and with those who are not here today.
verses.29:15: For you know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, how we passed through the midst of the nations, as you passed through.
verses.29:16: And you saw their abominations and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which are among them.
verses.29:17: Let there not be among you a man or woman or clan or tribe whose mind has turned away from the Lord your God, going to serve the gods of those nations; let there not be among you a root sprouting upward in gall and bitterness.
verses.29:18: And it will be, if he hears the words of this curse and blesses himself in his heart, saying, 'May holy things be mine, for I will walk in the wandering of my heart,' so that the sinner may not destroy the sinless along with himself,
verses.29:19: God will by no means be willing to pardon him, but rather then the anger of the Lord and His jealousy will blaze against that man, and all the curses of this covenant that are written in this book will cling to him, and the Lord will blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.29:20: And the Lord will separate him for calamities from all the sons of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in the book of this law.
verses.29:21: And the next generation, your sons who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who comes from a distant land will say, and they will see the plagues of that land and its diseases which the Lord sent upon it:
verses.29:22: sulfur and burned salt; its whole land will not be sown, nor will it sprout, nor will any green thing come up upon it, just as Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim were overthrown, which the Lord overthrew in fury and anger.
verses.29:23: And all the nations will say, 'Why has the Lord done thus to this land? What is this great fury of anger?'
verses.29:24: And they will say, 'Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord, the God of their fathers, which He made with their fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt,
verses.29:25: and they went and served other gods whom they did not know and whom He did not allot to them;
verses.29:26: and the Lord became angry with fury against that land, to bring upon it according to all the curses that are written in the book of this law;
verses.29:27: and the Lord removed them from their land in fury and anger and very great indignation, and cast them out into another land, as it is now.'
verses.29:28: The hidden things belong to the Lord your God, but the revealed things belong to you and to your children forever, to do all the words of this law."
verses.30:1: "And it will be, when all these words come upon you, the blessing and the curse which I have set before you, and you receive them into your heart among all the nations where the Lord scatters you,
verses.30:2: and you return to the Lord your God and listen to His voice according to all that I am commanding you today, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.30:3: then the Lord will heal your sins, and He will have mercy on you, and He will again gather you from all the nations into which the Lord scattered you.
verses.30:4: If your dispersion is from the end of heaven to the end of heaven, from there the Lord your God will gather you, and from there the Lord your God will take you.
verses.30:5: And your God will bring you in from there into the land which your fathers inherited, and you will inherit it; and He will do good to you, and He will make you more numerous than your fathers.
verses.30:6: And the Lord will thoroughly cleanse your heart and the heart of your seed, to love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
verses.30:7: And the Lord your God will put these curses upon your enemies and upon those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.30:8: And you will return to the Lord and listen to the voice of the Lord your God, and do His commandments which I am commanding you today.
verses.30:9: And the Lord your God will bless you in every work of your hands, in the offspring of your womb and in the produce of your land and in the offspring of your livestock. For the Lord your God will return to rejoice over you for good, just as He rejoiced over your fathers,
verses.30:10: if you listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments that are written in the book of this law, if you return to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.30:11: For this commandment which I am commanding you today is not too burdensome, nor is it far from you.
verses.30:12: It is not in heaven above, for one to say, 'Who will ascend for us into heaven and take it for us, and when we have heard it, we will do it?'
verses.30:13: Nor is it beyond the sea, for one to say, 'Who will cross over for us to the other side of the sea and take it for us and make it heard by us, and we will do it?'
verses.30:14: The word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart and in your hands, to do it.
verses.30:15: Look, I have set before you today life and death, good and evil.
verses.30:16: If you listen to the commandments of the Lord your God which I am commanding you today, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, to keep His statutes and His judgments, then you will live and become many, and the Lord your God will bless you in all the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.30:17: And if your heart turns away and you do not listen, and being led astray you bow down to other gods and serve them,
verses.30:18: I declare to you today that you will certainly perish, and you will by no means live many days upon the land into which you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it.
verses.30:19: I call both heaven and earth to witness against you today: I have set life and death before you, the blessing and the curse. Choose life, so that you and your seed may live,
verses.30:20: to love the Lord your God, to listen to His voice, and to hold fast to Him; for this is your life and the length of your days, that you may dwell upon the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give to them."
verses.31:1: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all the sons of Israel.
verses.31:2: And he said to them, "I am one hundred and twenty years old today; I will no longer be able to go in and go out, and the Lord said to me, 'You shall not cross this Jordan.'
verses.31:3: The Lord your God is the One who goes ahead before you; He will utterly destroy these nations from before you, and you will dispossess them. And Joshua is the one who goes ahead before you, just as the Lord spoke.
verses.31:4: And the Lord your God will do to them just as He did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, and to their land, as He utterly destroyed them,
verses.31:5: and the Lord delivered them to you; and you shall do to them just as I commanded you.
verses.31:6: Be courageous and be strong; do not fear, nor be fainthearted, nor be terrified before them, for the Lord your God is the One who goes ahead with you, among you; He will by no means let go of you, nor by any means abandon you."
verses.31:7: And Moses called Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be courageous and be strong, for you will go in before this people into the land that the Lord swore to our fathers to give to them, and you will apportion it as an inheritance to them.
verses.31:8: And the Lord, the One who goes along with you, will not let go of you, nor by any means abandon you. Do not fear, nor be fainthearted."
verses.31:9: And Moses wrote the words of this law in a book, and gave it to the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and to the elders of the sons of Israel.
verses.31:10: And Moses commanded them on that day, saying, "After seven years, at the time of the year of release, at the Festival of Tent-Pitching,
verses.31:11: when all Israel comes together to appear before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord chooses, you shall read this law in the presence of all Israel, in their hearing,
verses.31:12: having assembled the people, the men and the women and the children, and the resident alien who is in your cities, so that they may hear and so that they may learn to fear the Lord your God, and they will listen so as to do all the words of this law;
verses.31:13: and their sons, who do not know, will hear and will learn to fear the Lord your God all the days that they live on the land into which you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it there."
verses.31:14: And the Lord said to Moses, "Look, the days of your death have drawn near; call Joshua, and stand beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and I will command him." And Moses and Joshua went to the tent of testimony, and stood beside the doors of the tent of testimony.
verses.31:15: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and stood beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the pillar of the cloud stood beside the doors of the tent.
verses.31:16: And the Lord said to Moses, "Look, you are about to sleep with your fathers, and this people will rise up and prostitute itself after foreign gods of the land into which it is entering, and they will forsake Me and break My covenant that I made with them.
verses.31:17: And I will become angry with wrath against them on that day, and I will forsake them and turn My face away from them, and it will become prey; and many evils and afflictions will find it, and it will say on that day, 'Because the Lord my God is not in me, these evils have found me.'
verses.31:18: But I will surely turn My face away from them on that day on account of all the evil deeds that they did, because they turned away to foreign gods.
verses.31:19: And write the words of this song, and you shall teach it to the sons of Israel, and you shall put it into their mouth, so that this song may be for Me, testifying face to face among the sons of Israel.
verses.31:20: For I will bring them into the good land that I swore to their fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey; and they will eat and, having been filled, they will be satiated, and they will turn to foreign gods and provoke Me and break My covenant.
verses.31:21: And this song will stand in opposition, testifying face to face; for it will by no means be forgotten from the mouth of their seed. For I know their wickedness, all that they are doing here today before I bring them into the good land that I swore to their fathers."
verses.31:22: And Moses wrote this song on that day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.
verses.31:23: And he commanded Joshua and said, "Be courageous and be strong, for you will bring the sons of Israel into the land that the Lord swore to them, and He will be with you."
verses.31:24: Now when Moses finished writing all the words of this law in a book to the end,
verses.31:25: then he commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take the book of this law and place it at the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and it will be there among you as a testimony;
verses.31:27: for I know your provocation and your stiff neck. For while I am still living with you today, you have been rebellious in matters toward God; how will it not also be so after my death?
verses.31:28: Assemble to me your tribal leaders and your judges and your recorders, so that I may speak all these words in their hearing, and I call both heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.31:29: For I know that after my death you will surely act lawlessly, and you will turn aside from the way that I commanded you—the evils at the end of the days, because you will do what is wicked in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger by the works of your hands."
verses.31:30: And Moses spoke in the hearing of the whole assembly the words of this song to the end.
verses.32:1: Pay attention, heaven, and I will speak; and let the earth hear words from my mouth.
verses.32:2: Let my utterance be awaited like rain, and let my words come down like dew, like a shower upon wild grass, and like snowfall upon vegetation.
verses.32:3: For I have called on the name of the Lord; give greatness to our God.
verses.32:4: God, His works are true, and all His ways are judgments; a faithful God, and there is no unrighteousness; righteous and holy is the Lord.
verses.32:5: They have sinned, not His children, blemished ones; a crooked and distorted generation.
verses.32:6: Do you repay the Lord these things in this way, foolish people and not wise? Did not He Himself, your Father, acquire you and make you?
verses.32:7: Remember the days of old; understand the years of generations to generations. Ask your father, and he will declare to you; your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.32:8: When the Most High divided the nations, as He scattered the sons of Adam, He set the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the angels of God.
verses.32:9: And the Lord's portion became His people Jacob, the measured allotment of His inheritance, Israel.
verses.32:10: He provided sufficiently for him in the wilderness, in the thirst of scorching heat, in a waterless land; He encircled him and instructed him, and guarded him like the pupil of an eye.
verses.32:11: As an eagle shelters its nest and yearns over its young, spreading out His wings He received them and took them up upon His back.
verses.32:12: The Lord alone led them; there was no foreign god with them.
verses.32:13: He brought them up upon the strength of the land; He fed them the produce of fields; they sucked honey from a rock and oil from a solid rock;
verses.32:14: butter of cattle and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs and rams, young of bulls and male goats, with fat of kidneys of wheat; and the blood of the grape he drank as wine.
verses.32:15: And Jacob ate and was filled, and the beloved one kicked; he grew fat, he grew thick, he grew broad; and he forsook God who made him, and turned away from God his Savior.
verses.32:16: They provoked Me with foreign ones; with their abominations they embittered Me.
verses.32:17: They sacrificed to demons and not to God, to gods whom they had not known; new, recent ones have come, whom their fathers had not known.
verses.32:18: You forsook God who fathered you, and you forgot God who nourishes you.
verses.32:19: And the Lord saw and became jealous, and was provoked because of the anger of His sons and daughters.
verses.32:20: And He said, "I will turn My face away from them, and I will show what will happen to them in the last days. For it is a perverted generation, sons in whom there is no faithfulness.
verses.32:21: They made Me jealous with what is not a god; they provoked Me with their idols. And I will make them jealous with what is not a nation; with a nation without understanding I will rouse them to anger.
verses.32:22: For a fire has been kindled from My wrath; it will burn as far as Hades below; it will devour the earth and its produce; it will set ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
verses.32:23: I will gather evils against them, and with My arrows I will wage war against them.
verses.32:24: Wasting away with famine and with the devouring of birds, and an incurable spasm; I will send the teeth of wild beasts against them, with the venom of creatures crawling upon the earth.
verses.32:25: From outside a sword will make them childless, and from the inner chambers, terror: young man with virgin, nursing infant with an old man of settled age.
verses.32:26: I said, 'I will scatter them, and I will make the remembrance of them cease from among people,'
verses.32:27: were it not for the anger of enemies, so that they would not endure long, so that the adversaries would not join in attacking, and would not say, 'Our exalted hand, and not the Lord, has done all these things.'"
verses.32:28: It is a nation that has lost counsel, and there is no knowledge in them.
verses.32:29: They did not have the sense to understand; let them receive these things for the coming time.
verses.32:30: How will one pursue a thousand, and two dislodge ten thousands, unless God had sold them and the Lord had handed them over?
verses.32:31: For their gods are not like our God; and our enemies are senseless.
verses.32:32: For their vine is from the vine of Sodom, and their vine branch is from Gomorrah; their grape is a grape of gall, a cluster of bitterness is theirs.
verses.32:33: Their wine is the venom of dragons, and the incurable venom of asps.
verses.32:34: Look, have not these things been gathered with Me, and sealed in My treasuries?
verses.32:35: In the day of vengeance I will repay, when their foot slips; for the day of destruction is near for them, and what is prepared is at hand for you.
verses.32:36: For the Lord will judge His people, and He will be comforted over His servants; for He saw them paralyzed, and failing in affliction, and exhausted.
verses.32:37: And the Lord said, "Where are their gods, in whom they had trusted,
verses.32:38: the fat of whose sacrifices you ate, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you, and let them become protectors for you.
verses.32:39: See, see that I am, and there is no god besides Me; I kill and I will make alive; I will strike, and I will heal; and there is no one who will rescue from My hands.
verses.32:40: For I will lift up My hand to heaven, and I will swear by My right hand and say, 'I live forever.'
verses.32:41: For I will sharpen My sword like lightning, and My hand will take hold of judgment, and I will render justice to the enemies, and to those who hate I will repay;
verses.32:42: I will make My arrows drunk from the blood of the wounded and of captivity, from the head of the rulers of enemies."
verses.32:43: Rejoice, heavens, together with Him, and let the sons of God worship Him; rejoice, nations, with His people, and let all the angels of God grow strong in Him; for the blood of His sons is avenged, and He will take vengeance and repay justice to the enemies, and to those who hate He will repay, and the Lord will cleanse the land of His people.
verses.32:44: And Moses wrote this song on that day and taught it to the sons of Israel; and Moses went in and spoke all the words of this law into the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.32:45: And Moses finished speaking to all Israel.
verses.32:46: And he said to them, "Pay attention with your heart to all these words which I testify to you today, which you will command your sons, to keep and to do all the words of this law;
verses.32:47: for this is not an empty word for you, because this is your life; and because of this word you will live long upon the land into which you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it."
verses.32:48: And the Lord spoke to Moses on this day, saying,
verses.32:49: "Go up to Mount Abarim, this Mount Nebo which is in the land of Canaan opposite Jericho, and see the land of Canaan which I am giving to the sons of Israel;
verses.32:50: and die on the mountain to which you are going up, and be added to your people, just as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was added to his people;
verses.32:51: because you disobeyed My word among the sons of Israel at the water of Contention at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not sanctify Me among the sons of Israel.
verses.32:52: You will see the land opposite, and you will not enter there."
verses.33:1: And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the sons of Israel before his death.
verses.33:2: And he said, "The Lord has come from Sinai, and appeared from Seir to us; and He hastened down from Mount Paran with tens of thousands of Kadesh; at His right hand were angels with Him.
verses.33:3: And He spared His people, and all the sanctified ones are under Your hands; and these are under You, and he received from His words,
verses.33:4: a law which Moses commanded you, an inheritance for the congregations of Jacob.
verses.33:5: And there will be a ruler in the beloved one, when the rulers of the peoples are gathered together with the tribes of Israel.
verses.33:6: Let Reuben live and not die, and let him be many in number."
verses.33:7: And this is for Judah: "Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and may You come to his people; and his hands will judge for him, and You will be a helper against the enemies."
verses.33:8: And to Levi he said, "Give to Levi his manifestations, and his truth to the devout man, whom they tested at Testing; they reviled him at the water of Contention.
verses.33:9: Saying to his father and to his mother, 'I have not seen you,' he also did not recognize his brothers, and he disowned his sons; he guarded Your oracles, and preserved Your covenant.
verses.33:10: They will make known Your statutes to Jacob, and Your law to Israel; they will place incense in Your wrath continually upon Your altar.
verses.33:11: Bless, Lord, his strength, and accept the works of his hands; shatter the loins of enemies who have risen up against him, and let those who hate him not rise."
verses.33:12: And to Benjamin he said, "Beloved by the Lord, he will dwell in confidence, and God overshadows him all the days, and between his shoulders He rested."
verses.33:13: And to Joseph he said, "Under the blessing of the Lord is his land, from the seasons of heaven and dew, and from the deeps of springs below,
verses.33:14: and according to the season of the yields of the sun's turnings, and from the conjunctions of the months,
verses.33:15: from the summit of mountains of the beginning, and from the summit of everlasting hills,
verses.33:16: and according to the season of the fullness of the earth; and may the things acceptable to the One who appeared in the bush come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the crown of one glorified among brothers.
verses.33:17: A firstborn of a bull is his beauty; the horns of a unicorn are his horns; with them he will gore nations together as far as the end of the earth. These are the tens of thousands of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.33:18: And to Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar in his tents.
verses.33:19: They will utterly destroy nations; and you will call out there, and you will sacrifice a sacrifice of righteousness; because the wealth of the sea will nurse you, and the markets of those who inhabit the coast."
verses.33:20: And to Gad he said, "Blessed is the One who enlarges Gad; like a lion he rested, having crushed an arm and a ruler.
verses.33:21: And he saw his firstfruits, because there was apportioned a land of rulers gathered together with leaders of peoples; the Lord did righteousness, and His judgment with Israel."
verses.33:22: And to Dan he said, "Dan is a lion's cub, and he will leap out from Bashan."
verses.33:23: And to Naphtali he said, "Naphtali is a fullness of acceptable things, and let him be filled with blessing from the Lord; he will inherit the sea and the south."
verses.33:24: And to Asher he said, "Blessed above children is Asher, and he will be acceptable to his brothers. He will dip his foot in oil;
verses.33:25: iron and bronze will be his sandal; as your days are, so is your strength.
verses.33:26: There is none like the God of the beloved one; the One who rides upon heaven is your helper, and the Majestic One of the vault.
verses.33:27: And the rule of God will shelter you, and you are under the strength of everlasting arms; He will drive out an enemy from before you, saying, 'Perish!'
verses.33:28: And Israel will dwell in confidence, alone upon the land of Jacob, with grain and wine, and heaven is clouded with dew for you.
verses.33:29: Blessed are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord? Your helper will shield you, and the sword is your boast; and your enemies will lie to you, and you will tread upon their neck."
verses.34:1: And Moses went up from Araboth of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the summit of Pisgah, which faces Jericho; and the Lord showed him all the land of Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.34:2: and all the land of Naphtali, and all the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah as far as the farthest sea,
verses.34:3: and the wilderness, and the surrounding region of Jericho, the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.
verses.34:4: And the Lord said to Moses, "This is the land which I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, saying, 'To your seed I will give it'; and I have shown it to your eyes, and you will not enter there."
verses.34:5: And Moses, the servant of the Lord, died in the land of Moab by the word of the Lord.
verses.34:6: And they buried him in Gai near the house of Peor; and no one knows his burial place until this day.
verses.34:7: Now Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eyes were not dimmed, nor did they decay.
verses.34:8: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in Araboth of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho for thirty days; and the days of mourning of the weeping for Moses were completed.
verses.34:9: And Joshua son of Nun was filled with a spirit of understanding, for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the sons of Israel listened to him, and did just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.34:10: And no prophet has arisen again in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.34:11: in all the signs and wonders, he whom the Lord sent to do them in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to his attendants and to all his land,
verses.34:12: the great marvels and the mighty hand, which Moses did before all Israel.

notes.1:1: Greek preserves two LXX-distinct place names, Aulon (MT "Hazeroth") and Catachrysea (lit. "gold-covered places," translating MT "Di-zahab"). It also reads "toward the west" (MT "in the Arabah") and "near the Red [Sea]" with "Sea" implied.
notes.1:7: Greek specifically names the Anti-Lebanon range (Antilibanos), whereas the Hebrew MT reads "Lebanon."
notes.1:8: Greek reads the third-person perfect "He has delivered" (paradedoken) before shifting to the first-person "I swore" (omosa), whereas the Hebrew MT uses first person in both clauses.
notes.1:24: Greek translates the Hebrew place name "Valley of Eshcol" literally into Greek as "the Valley of the Cluster" (Pharangos botryos).
notes.1:40: Greek uses the aorist indicative "you encamped" (estratopedeusate), resuming Moses's narration after the Lord's speech ends in v. 39, rather than an imperative command as in the Hebrew MT.
notes.2:7: The Greek text begins with "the Lord our God" and reads the imperative "Consider how you passed through that great and fearsome wilderness," whereas the Hebrew MT has "the Lord your God" and "He knows your wandering through this great wilderness."
notes.2:8: The Greek text reads "Ailon" (for MT "Elath") and "your brothers" (for MT "our brothers").
notes.2:9: The Greek text reads "Seir" here and in 2:18, and "Aroer" in 2:29, where the Hebrew MT reads "Ar."
notes.2:20: "Zochomein" is the Greek text's distinct name for the people called "Zamzummim" in the Hebrew MT.
notes.2:23: The Greek text identifies these peoples and places as the "Hivites," "Hasedoth," and "Cappadocians" from "Cappadocia," corresponding to MT "Avvim," "Hazerim," and "Caphtorim" from "Caphtor."
notes.2:25: The Greek text reads the second-person imperative "begin to put" (continuing the imperative in v. 24) and "your name," whereas the Hebrew MT reads "I will begin to put" and "the report of you."
notes.3:1: The Greek text reads "Gog" here and in 3:13, while using "Og" in vv. 3, 4, 10, and 11.
